ആര്‍ക്കും അതിന് മറുപടി പറയാന്‍ സാധിക്കില്ല. അതിനു കാരണം യുഗധര്‍മം എന്താണെന്ന് അറിയാത്തതുകൊണ്ടുതന്നെ. ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ള മഹാന്മാര്‍ എത്രയോ അന്വേഷിച്ചുമുട്ടിയ അനേകം പിരിവുകളാണ് നമ്മുടെ രാജ്യത്തിന്‍റെ കൈമുതലായിട്ടുള്ളത്. ഇതിനെ ഒരു ഗുരുപരമ്പര എന്നുള്ള നിലയ്ക്ക് നിങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് മനസ്സിലാക്കിക്കാന്‍ പലപ്രാവശ്യം ഒരുങ്ങിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. പക്ഷേ അവിടെയെല്ലാം നിങ്ങളുടെ ബുദ്ധിയുടെ കഴിവും കുടുംബമഹിമയും പഠിപ്പിന്‍റെ കലാവിരുതും ഇങ്ങനെ ആടിയും കുഴഞ്ഞും വീണുപോയ കര്‍മം നമുക്ക് മുന്‍ഗാമികളില്‍ നിന്ന് കിട്ടിയിട്ടില്ലേ എന്ന് ചിന്തിക്കുക! ഇതിനെയൊന്ന് തെരിയപ്പെടുത്താന്‍ നിങ്ങളോട് പറയുകയാണ്. ഇത് എളുപ്പം നിങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് മനസ്സിലാവുകയുമില്ല--നിങ്ങളുടെ കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളെ ആ വഴിക്ക് മാറ്റിയെടുക്കാന്‍ കഴിവില്ലെന്ന്. വെറും തൊണ്ടടിച്ച് ജീവിക്കുന്ന മാതാവിന്‍റെ അറിവാണ് കുട്ടിയുടെ ഉള്ളില്‍ നില്‍ക്കുന്നത്. ഈ അറിവ് ആരോട് എങ്ങനെ എന്തുപോലെ ചോദിക്കും? ഇത് നിങ്ങള്‍ തന്നെ നിങ്ങളുടെ വീട്ടില്‍ ഈ വക കാര്യങ്ങള്‍ തുറന്നുപറഞ്ഞാല്‍ ഇതിന് ഇത്രയും വലിയ ഒരു ശബ്ദം വരുത്തിക്കൂട്ടാനില്ല. ഇത് ഈ ഇരുപത്തിയഞ്ചു ചതുര്‍യുഗമായി വന്നുപോയിട്ടുള്ള ചതുര്‍യുഗത്തിന്‍റെ കണക്കൊക്കെ നിങ്ങള്‍ നോക്കിക്കൊള്ളുക--നിങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് കിട്ടും. പഠിച്ചല്ല നോക്കേണ്ടത്. നിങ്ങളുടെ ഗുരു എവിടെ എന്തുപോലെ ചെയ്തിരുന്നു? അതിന് നിങ്ങള്‍ അന്ന് എന്തുപോലെ സാക്ഷിയാണ്? ഇത് ദൈവം നിങ്ങളെക്കൊണ്ട് തിരിച്ചെടുപ്പിക്കാന്‍ ഒരു പരമ്പര സൃഷ്ടിച്ചതാണ്. ഇത് ആണും പെണ്ണും തെറ്റുചെയ്ത് ചീത്തയാക്കരുത്. ഈ ത്രിമൂര്‍ത്തിവശവും മനുസ്മൃതിയും ഇല്ലാത്തതല്ല. ഇതുപോലെ പ്രവാചകപരമ്പര. അതില്‍ സിദ്ധിയും കഴിവും മന്ത്രവി ദ്യയും കാരുണ്യം തുളുമ്പുന്ന ദൈവത്തിന്‍റെ മുമ്പില്‍ വരുമ്പോള്‍ എന്തു കഴിവുണ്ടോ അതെല്ലാം ഇവര്‍ ഉപയോഗിക്കാന്‍ കൊള്ളാത്ത വിധത്തില്‍ ആക്കിയിട്ട് പോകും. ഇതിപ്പോള്‍ നമുക്കെങ്ങനെ കിട്ടിയെന്ന് ചൊദ്യം ചെയ്യരുത്. എന്തെന്നാല്‍ ശാസ്ത്രമൂലിക കാലങ്ങള്‍ നാലാക്കിത്തിരിച്ചിട്ട് അത് ബ്രാഹ്മണ, ക്ഷത്രിയ, വൈശ്യ, ശൂദ്ര എന്നെഴുതി വച്ചു. ഇതിന്‍റെ കാലയളവ് എത്രയായിക്കാണുമെന്ന് തോന്നുന്നു നമുക്ക്? ഇത് ഒരു ഗുരുമുഖത്തു നിന്ന് അറിഞ്ഞില്ലെങ്കില്‍ കാര്യങ്ങള്‍ ആര്‍ക്കും പറയാന്‍ കഴിയില്ല. ഇത് ഇത്രയും കാര്യങ്ങള്‍ നിങ്ങളെ സംബന്ധിച്ചിടത്തോളം സത്യമാണെന്ന് എല്ലാവര്‍ക്കുമറിയാം. ഈ സത്യത്തിനു വേണ്ടി ജീവിച്ചു പഠിക്കാന്‍ എത്രയെത്ര മഹാത്മാക്കള്‍ നമ്മുടെ മുന്‍പില്‍!

അതുപോലെ പൈശാചികകര്‍മം ഒരുപാടു വിധത്തില്‍ പറയുന്നു. ഇതിനെയൊക്കെ പൂര്‍ത്തിയാക്കിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്നാല്‍ എത്ര യുഗങ്ങളായാണ് നമ്മള്‍ ചത്തുകെട്ട് നാശം വിതയ്ക്കുന്ന കര്‍മവുമായിട്ട് തിരിച്ചുവന്നിരിക്കുന്നത്. അതിന് ഓരോ തെളിവുകള്‍ നിങ്ങള്‍ സ്നേഹമുള്ളവരോട് ഒപ്പിച്ച് എഴുതിവച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. ഇത് ഞാനും ചില കുട്ടികളോട് പറയുന്നത് കേട്ടിട്ടുണ്ട്. അന്നെല്ലാം എനിക്ക് അവര്‍ പറയുന്നത് തന്നെയാണ് ശരിയെന്ന് തോന്നിയിരുന്നു. അങ്ങനെയൊരു ഭാഗ്യം നമുക്ക് ഭാരതത്തിന് ഏറ്റെടുക്കാനുള്ള ഒരു കഴിവു സമ്പാദിക്കലാണ് നമ്മുടെ ഭരണകൂടം. അത് അവരും നിങ്ങളുമായി ചിന്തിച്ചിട്ട് ഇതെങ്ങനെ വേണം എന്ന് ചോദിക്കുന്നത്, അവരോട് ചോദിച്ചാല്‍ കിട്ടുകയില്ല. ഇതുകൊണ്ട് മനുഷ്യലോകം മൊത്തം ഈ പൈശാചികകര്‍മത്തില്‍ എത്തിച്ചേര്‍ന്നു നിന്നുകൊണ്ട് ഈ അച്ഛന്‍റെ കര്‍മമെന്താണെന്നോ, അമ്മയുടെ കര്‍മമെന്താണെന്നോ ഈ കുട്ടിയുടെ കര്‍മമെന്താണെന്നോ ഇവര്‍ക്ക് സൂക്ഷിച്ചറിയാന്‍ കഴിയുകയില്ല. അതുകൊണ്ട് നിങ്ങളുടെ കാലം തേച്ചു കളഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ട് പോകരുത്. ദൈവശിക്ഷ നമ്മുടെ ഈ പ്രകൃതി മാത്രമല്ല ലോകവ്യവസായം, ലോകമണ്ഡലം ഇതെല്ലാം നമ്മുടെ പൂര്‍വികന്മാര്‍ അതിന്‍റെ ഭംഗിയായിട്ട് നല്ല തെളിവില്‍ എഴുതിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. പക്ഷേ ഈ പണ്ഡിതന്മാര്‍ ഏറ്റുപറയുകയില്ല. പണ്ഡിതന്മാരെന്നു പറയുന്നത്, നമുക്ക് രണ്ട് തരമുണ്ടല്ലോ. ഒന്ന് തീര്‍ക്കാന്‍ നോക്കിയാല്‍ എവിടെയും മൂടും താളിയുമില്ല.

ഈശ്വരനിദാനം, അത് ആദ്യമായിട്ട് ഇവിടെ കാണിച്ചുതുടങ്ങിയത് ബുദ്ധന്‍റെ പരമ്പരയാണ്. സത്യം പറഞ്ഞെങ്കിലും ജീവിച്ചുപോകാന്‍ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല. ഇത് നിങ്ങളെല്ലാപേരും മനസ്സിലാക്കാന്‍ വേണ്ടി പറയുന്നത്. ഇവിടെ ബസ്സില്‍ പോകാം, സൈക്കിളില്‍ പോകാം, കാളവണ്ടിയില്‍ പോകാം, നടന്നു പോകാം. ഇത് ഒരു തെളിവായി നിങ്ങള്‍ എടുക്കുക. ഇതിന്‍റെ കാര്യം ഇതല്ല. അതൊക്കെ പിന്നാലെ പറഞ്ഞുകൊള്ളാം. ഇങ്ങനെ എല്ലാവരും, നിങ്ങള്‍, അറിയത്തക്കവിധത്തില്‍ ജീവിതം സൂക്ഷിച്ചുകൊള്ളണം. ഇതിനു വേണ്ടിയാണ് നിങ്ങള്‍ ഗുരുപൂജ ചെയ്തത്. പക്ഷേ ഗുരുപൂജയുടെ യഥാര്‍ത്ഥത്തോളം നിങ്ങള്‍ അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ല. അത് പിന്നീട് പറഞ്ഞുതരാം. നിങ്ങള്‍ അതു ശക്തിയായി സൂക്ഷിച്ചില്ലെങ്കില്‍ ദൈവത്തില്‍നിന്ന് കിട്ടുന്ന ദോഷമാകും അത്. ഓരോന്നും നിങ്ങള്‍ വിശദീകരിച്ചു കാണാന്‍ കഴിയുന്ന ഒരു സത്യത്തിന്‍റെ പിന്നിലാണ്. ഒരുവിധപ്പെട്ടവരാരും ഇത് സമ്മതിക്കാറില്ല.
ഗുരുവാണി

മാര്‍ച്ച് 2005 എന്താണ് നമ്മുടെ രാജ്യത്തിന്‍റെ അധഃപതനം എന്ന് ആദ്യം കാണണം. അവിടെയാണ് നമുക്ക് ഏറ്റവും അമളിപറ്റിയിരിക്കുന്നത്. നമ്മുടെ രാജ്യത്തിനുള്ള അമളി ആദ്യംതന്നെ ഏതെങ്കിലുമൊരു ജീവിതക്രമം അനുസരിച്ചുവന്ന - ഒന്നെങ്കില്‍ അതിന്‍റെ പോരായ്മ, അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ അതിന്‍റെ പൈശാചികത്വം കലര്‍ന്ന ഭരണം. ഇങ്ങനെയാണ് നമുക്ക് വന്നത്. ഈ ഭരണവും പൈശാചികത്വവും കൂടി നിന്നുള്ള ആ കര്‍മത്തില്‍ നമ്മളെ സംബന്ധിച്ച് ഇതൊന്നും അറിയാത്ത നമ്മുടെ വീഴ്ചതാഴ്ചകള്‍ ഒരു തരത്തിലും പറഞ്ഞൊപ്പിക്കാന്‍ വയ്യാത്തവിധം നമുക്ക് സംഭവിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. അതു നമുക്ക് ഇവിടെ മാത്രമല്ല, അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ നമ്മുടെ ഈ ഭാരതത്തില്‍ മാത്രമല്ല, ഉലകത്തിന്‍റെ എല്ലാ ഭാഗത്തും ഇത് അങ്ങനെ സംഭവിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. എന്നാല്‍ ഇത് മാറ്റിയെടുക്കാന്‍ നമ്മളോളം വളര്‍ന്ന ആ ചിന്താശീലം എന്തുപോലെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു, ഇന്ന് നമ്മള്‍ എന്താണ് ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നത്, നമ്മള്‍ ഇത് എങ്ങനെ എടുക്കും എന്നൊന്നും നമുക്ക് പറഞ്ഞുകിട്ടാന്‍ മാര്‍ഗമില്ലാത്ത വിധത്തില്‍ നമ്മള്‍ ഓരോരുത്തരും എന്തോ ഒക്കെ നമ്മുടെ ബുദ്ധിക്ക് ഒത്ത് ഒക്കെ ചെയ്തുപോകുന്നതൊഴിച്ചാല്‍ ഒന്നും ചെയ്യുന്നില്ല. പിന്നെ ഇതിന്‍റെ വീഴ്ച എവിടെയാണ് എന്ന് ഒരു ചെറിയ കാഴ്ചപ്പാടില്‍ നമുക്ക് കാണാം. ചെറുതല്ല, വലുതാണ്. പക്ഷേ നിങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് അത് അങ്ങനെ പറഞ്ഞാല്‍ ഒക്കില്ലല്ലോ. ഈ കലികാലത്തിനു മുന്‍പ് ജനിച്ച അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ കലികാലത്തിന്‍റെയും ദ്വാപരത്തിന്‍റെയും ആ സന്ധി(ഒന്നിന് തുടക്കം, ഒന്നിന് അവസാനം)യില്‍ ജനിച്ച ഒരാളാണ് ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണന്‍. പക്ഷേ അത് ഒരു തരത്തില്‍ പറഞ്ഞാല്‍ നമ്മള്‍ ഇന്നോളം ചിന്തിച്ച് കണ്ടിട്ടില്ലാത്ത ഒരു വലിയ ദുഃഖത്തിന്‍റെ ഭാരച്ചുമടാണ് ആ കണ്ടത്. പക്ഷേ നിങ്ങള്‍ അതിനെ വേറെ വഴിക്ക് എഴുതിനിറച്ച് വേണ്ടാത്ത രീതിയിലൊക്കെ അതിനെ പഠിപ്പിച്ച് എല്ലാം ഗീതാകാരന്‍ പറയുന്നു എന്നുപറഞ്ഞിട്ട് ഈ പണ്ഡിതന്മാരും പാമരന്മാരും അറിയാതെ വീഴുന്ന കുഴിക്ക് വല്ല എണ്ണവുമുണ്ടോ? എങ്ങനെ എണ്ണിത്തുലയ്ക്കും ഇത്? അപ്പോള്‍ ഇതല്ല നമുക്ക് ഇന്നു വേണ്ടത്. ഗീതാകാരന്‍ പറഞ്ഞത് ശരിയാണ്. ഈ ഗീതാകാരനെ അംഗീകരിച്ചോ? അംഗീകരിച്ചെങ്കില്‍ എങ്ങനെയാണ് നമ്മള്‍ അംഗീകരിച്ചത്? ഇവിടെയാണ് നമ്മുടെ പിശക്. അനേക കാലങ്ങളായി അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ ദൈവനിശ്ചയം യുഗാന്തരങ്ങളായി കൊണ്ടുവന്ന ആ നീണ്ട ചരിത്രത്തിന് നമുക്കെന്തെങ്കിലും പറയാനുണ്ടോ എന്ന് ചോദിച്ചാല്‍, അത് ഇല്ല. അക്ഷരം കീറി വ്യാഖ്യാനിക്കുന്നത് ഏറ്റവും മിടുക്കായിട്ട് കണ്ടിട്ട് ഈ മിടുക്കിന്‍റെ പിന്നില്‍ ഒളിച്ചിരിപ്പാണ് നമ്മുടെ ഓരോരുത്തരുടെയും പണി. പക്ഷേ ഇതുകൊണ്ട് നിങ്ങളുടെ ആത്മാവിനോ എന്‍റെ ആത്മാവിനോ ഇനി ലോകത്ത് ഏതെങ്കിലും ആത്മാവിനോ ഗുണം കിട്ടുമോ, ഇത് കീറിപ്പറിച്ച് എടുത്തുപറഞ്ഞുതന്നാല്‍? ഇതൊക്കെ കേട്ടുരസിച്ച് കളയാനേ ഒക്കൂ. നിങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തില്‍ ഉതകുന്ന കര്‍മം ചെയ്തെടുക്കാന്‍ നിങ്ങളെക്കൊണ്ട് കഴിയാതെ വരും. അപ്പോള്‍ നിങ്ങള്‍ ജനിച്ച കാലത്തെപ്പറ്റി, ആ ജനിച്ച കാലം കലിയാണെന്ന് പറയുകയും, കലി നമുക്ക് നല്ലതല്ല എന്ന് പറയുകയും ചെയ്യുന്ന ഒരു കര്‍മഗതിയില്‍ നിന്നുകൊണ്ട് നാം ഇത് എങ്ങനെ നന്നാക്കി എടുക്കും? ഒരിക്കലും കലി ചീത്തയല്ല എന്ന് നിങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് തോന്നുക. അതാണ് ഏറ്റവും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു കാര്യം. എന്താണ്? ഈ ശൂദ്രനിലേക്ക് ഇതെല്ലാം ബ്രഹ്മജ്ഞാനത്തിന് അവസരം ഉണ്ടാക്കിക്കൊടുത്ത ആ ദൈവനിശ്ചയത്തോട് നമ്മള്‍ പിണക്കം പ്രാപിച്ചു നില്‍ക്കുകയാണ്. അതിനൊരു ഉദാഹരണമാണ് ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണന്‍.

കാരണം ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണന്‍ ജനിക്കുന്നതിനുമുന്‍പ് ഇവിടെ അപാകത ഉണ്ടെന്ന് തെളിയിച്ചതാണ് കംസനെപ്പറ്റിയുള്ള ചരിത്രം. കംസന്‍ ദുഷ്ടന്‍ ആണെന്നാണ് നമ്മളെ പറഞ്ഞുപഠിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത്. ഒരിക്കലും അല്ല. കംസന്‍ ഒരു രാജാവായിരുന്നു. ആ രാജാവിന്‍റെ ധര്‍മം അവന്‍ ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ട്. പക്ഷേ ആ രാജധര്‍മം ഏതുവരെ എങ്ങനെയാണ് ചെയ്യേണ്ടത്, യുഗധര്‍മത്തിന്‍റെ ഭാവനാരീതിയില്‍ നമ്മള്‍ എന്തായി - ഇതൊന്നും നമുക്ക് അറിയാന്‍ കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ല. അതുകൊണ്ട് നമുക്ക് എന്തുപറ്റി? 'ഇന്നലെ ചെയ്ത അബദ്ധങ്ങള്‍ ഇന്ന് ശാസ്ത്രമായിട്ടു വരും' എന്ന് ആശാന്‍ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ അങ്ങനെ വന്നിരിക്കുകയാണ്. ഇത് അബദ്ധമാണ് നമ്മള്‍ ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നതെന്ന് നമുക്ക് ബോധവുമില്ല. അതാണ് ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണന്‍ ജനിക്കുന്നതിനുമുന്‍പ് ഏഴു കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളെയും തല്ലിക്കൊന്ന്, ഒരു മാതാപിതാവിന്‍റെ ആ ദുഃഖത്തെപ്പറ്റി നിങ്ങള്‍ ചിന്തിക്കുക. ഏഴു എണ്ണത്തെയും തല്ലിക്കൊന്നു, എട്ടാമത്തേതിനെ കൈയില്‍ കിട്ടാത്തതുകൊണ്ട് കൊന്നില്ല എന്നൊക്കെയാണ് നമ്മള്‍ ചരിത്രം കൊണ്ട് അറിയുന്നത്. അത് സത്യമാണെങ്കില്‍ ഈ ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണനെപ്പറ്റി നമുക്ക് അറിയാനോ ഈ പ്രജകള്‍ക്ക് ഒരു നേട്ടമോ അറിവോ ഉണ്ടാക്കാതിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ട് എന്തുപറ്റി? അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ അനേകം രാജാക്കന്മാര്‍തന്നെ, പത്ത് അറുന്നൂറിലധികം നാട്ടുരാജാക്കന്മാര്‍ ഭരിച്ചിരുന്ന ഈ സ്ഥലത്ത് മറ്റൊരു രാജാവിന്‍റെ ഗുണം വേറൊരു രാജാവിനില്ല. അങ്ങനെ പൊരുതി ജയിച്ച കര്‍മച്ചുഴിയില്‍ വീണതുപോലെ അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ അതില്‍തന്നെ കിടന്ന് അനുഭവിച്ച് നരകിക്കുന്നതുപോലെ. അങ്ങനെ ഈ രാജാക്കന്മാര്‍ അന്നോടന്ന് കൊണ്ടുവന്ന ഈ അറിവുകേടിന്‍റെയും അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ നമ്മുടെ ശാസ്ത്രപരമ്പരയ്ക്ക് ഏതൊക്കെ ചെയ്യാന്‍ കഴിഞ്ഞെന്ന് നോക്കി സമയം കളയുകയല്ലാതെ നമ്മളെക്കൊണ്ട് ഇന്നോളം അതെടുത്ത് എന്താണെന്ന് അറിഞ്ഞ് പ്രവര്‍ത്തിക്കാന്‍ നമുക്ക് ആയിട്ടില്ല. ആകുന്നുമില്ല. ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണന്‍റെ ജന്മം ഇങ്ങനെ വന്ന് വളര്‍ന്നു. പക്ഷേ ആ ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണനെ സൂക്ഷിക്കാന്‍ ഇവിടത്തെ ജനങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് അറിയാന്‍ വയ്യാതെ വന്നു. അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ രാജാക്കന്മാര്‍ക്ക് അറിയാന്‍ വയ്യാതെ വന്നു. അതിന്‍റെ ഫലമായിട്ട് ഈ രാജാവിന് അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ള ആ കംസന്‍റെ ജീവിതം എന്താണെന്ന് കാണിച്ചു തന്നിട്ട് നമുക്ക് മനസിലായില്ല. കംസന്‍ ഒരിക്കലും ദുഷ്ടനല്ല. എന്താണ്? 'പ്രത്യക്ഷാവഹം ധര്‍മം'.

പ്രത്യക്ഷീകരിച്ച് ആര് പറഞ്ഞുതരുന്നുവോ അതിനെ കേള്‍ക്കുന്നതാണ് രാജാവ്. അപ്പോള്‍ ദൈവം അവന്‍റെ പ്രത്യക്ഷത്തില്‍ നില്‍ക്കുകയാണ്. ആ പ്രത്യക്ഷത്തില്‍ നിന്നുകൊണ്ട് ദൈവം എന്തുചെയ്യുകയാണ്? അവന് ധര്‍മം പറഞ്ഞുകൊടുക്കുകയാണ്. അപ്പോള്‍ ആ ധര്‍മത്തില്‍ അവന്‍ ഉറച്ചു നിന്ന് പ്രവര്‍ത്തിച്ചു എന്നതൊഴിച്ചാല്‍ ഒരു കുറ്റം കംസന്‍ ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല. ഇതിനെ ഓരോന്നിനെയും തല്ലിക്കൊല്ലാന്‍ പറഞ്ഞതനുസരിച്ച് കൊന്നു. പക്ഷേ ഇത് എന്തുകൊണ്ടാണ് ഇവന്‍ ഇങ്ങനെ ചെയ്തതെന്ന് ചിന്തിക്കാനുള്ള ഒരു പാരമ്പര്യം ഇവിടത്തെ രാജാക്കന്മാര്‍ക്കോ ഇവിടത്തെ പണ്ഡിതന്മാര്‍ക്കോ അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ ജ്ഞാനികള്‍ക്ക് ആ വശം നിന്ന് തിരുത്തി പറഞ്ഞുകൊടുക്കാനോ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല എന്നുള്ളതാണ് ഇതിന്‍റെ ഏറ്റവും വലിയ ദുരിതം. എന്തുകൊണ്ട് അത് തിരുത്തി പറഞ്ഞു കൊടുക്കാന്‍ ഇവര്‍ക്ക് കഴിഞ്ഞില്ല? അത് വേറൊരു വശം. അത് ഇപ്പോള്‍ നമ്മള്‍ കേട്ടുവച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ത്രിമൂര്‍ത്തിസമ്പ്രദായത്തിലും അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ ശാക്തേയം, ശൈവം, വൈഷ്ണവം എന്നു പറഞ്ഞ് നമ്മള്‍ ഓരോരുത്തരും കൊണ്ടാടുന്ന ആ കര്‍മഗതിയുടെ അടിയില്‍നിന്നുകൊണ്ട് നേര്‍ച്ചകാഴ്ചകളുടെ തൂക്കം വലുതാക്കിയും ചെറുതാക്കിയും കുറിക്കലാണ് നമ്മുടെ വേല. ഇതുകൊണ്ട് ദൈവത്തെ തൃപ്തിപ്പെടുത്തി എന്നൊക്കെയാണ് നമ്മള്‍ ധരിച്ചുവച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത്. അങ്ങനെ ഒരിക്കലും നമുക്ക് കഴിയില്ല. അങ്ങനെ കഴിയുന്നത് ദൈവവുമല്ല. പിന്നെ എന്താണ്? നമ്മള്‍ ഒന്ന് വിശ്വസിക്കേണ്ടതുണ്ട്. എന്തുകൊണ്ട്? നമ്മള്‍ ഒരു ക്ഷേത്രം ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നു. അല്ലെങ്കില്‍ ആ ക്ഷേത്രപരമ്പരയില്‍ക്കൂടി എന്താണ് നടന്നത്, ആ ക്ഷേത്രം ആരാധിച്ചുപോയ പൂര്‍വികരുടെ കര്‍മഗതി എപ്പോഴത്തേക്ക് ഒക്കെ ആയിരുന്നു, ഇപ്പോള്‍ എവിടെയാണ് നമ്മള്‍ നില്‍ക്കുന്നത്. ഈ കലിയുടെ ധര്‍മത്തില്‍ ക്ഷേത്രപരമ്പര എന്തു ചെയ്യണമെന്ന് നമ്മളോട് പറഞ്ഞുതന്നിട്ടില്ല. അതോടൊപ്പം ത്രേതായുഗവും ദ്വാപരവും ഈ ദേവന്‍റെ കാലങ്ങളായിട്ടാണ് എപ്പോഴും എവിടെയും പറഞ്ഞുകേട്ടിട്ടുള്ളത്. അപ്പോള്‍ ഇത് തിരിച്ചറിയാന്‍ വയ്യാത്തതുകൊണ്ട്, സത്യയുഗത്തില്‍ അതിന്‍റെ ധര്‍മം നടന്നു. ത്രേതായുഗത്തിലും ദ്വാപരത്തിങ്കലും അതിന്‍റെ ധര്‍മം നടന്നു. പക്ഷേ ഒരു ഗുരുപരമ്പരയിലാണ് അത് നടന്നതെന്നു പറഞ്ഞാല്‍ നമുക്ക് വിശ്വസിക്കാന്‍ ഒക്കില്ല. എന്തുകൊണ്ട്? ഋഷിമാര്‍ വരെ ഈ ദേവനെ പൂജിച്ചും ആരാധിച്ചും പ്രവര്‍ത്തിച്ചു കാണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന കര്‍മം നമ്മുടെ മുന്‍പിലുണ്ട്. പക്ഷേ ഇത് എന്തുകൊണ്ടാണ് എന്ന് പറയാനുള്ള ഒരു കര്‍മം നമുക്ക് കിട്ടിയിട്ടില്ല. എന്താണ് കാരണം? ഈ മന്വന്തരത്തെപ്പറ്റിയുള്ള വിശദവിവരങ്ങള്‍ നമുക്കറിയില്ല. അതല്ല, ഏതെങ്കിലും ഒരു കാര്യം നമുക്ക് അറിയില്ല. അപ്പോള്‍ മന്വന്തരമെന്ന് പറയുമ്പോള്‍ ഒരു മനുവിന്‍റെ കാലത്തെപ്പറ്റിയാണ്. അപ്പോള്‍ ഒരു മനുവിന്‍റെ കാലം പറയുന്നത് എഴിപത്തിയൊന്നു ചതുര്‍യുഗമാണ്. ഈ എഴുപത്തിയൊന്നു ചതുര്‍യുഗത്തില്‍, ഏറ്റവും കുറഞ്ഞ ഒരു അളവാണ് ഈ കലി.
ഗുരുവാണി
en: January 2004

In this concept referred to as Manvantara, the matter of Brahma is not evident. It is only in the seventh Manvantara that the concept of Brahma is observed. You might even question whether God is unaware of why such a concept arose. Whenever a kingdom or a position is conferred, when that position is assumed, it is taken up in accordance with the respective era. Our ancestors lacked the experience to assume this position. If dharma in accordance with the times is not enforced, it will result in a flaw within this evolutionary theory. Therefore, it was introduced without allowing such an error. However, this is perceived only up to the heavenly realms by certain seers and a few other individuals. The reality of the rest is different. It ultimately comes down to the calculations of a solar system. It will have to be articulated how many Brahmas exist for the solar system, what their nature is, what they are, and why they came into being. Living a life devoid of this knowledge, or when the greatest scholar rewrites following the texts written until then, and attains success to the extent of their fortune, it is reduced to mere literal interpretation. Consequently, the meaning of the word changes. When it changes in this manner, numerous kinds of confusions arise among us. Readers of the Ramayana will exaggerate and state it emphatically. How so? 'Ra' must change. When asked what that implies, they assert that likes and dislikes (*Raga-Dvesha*) must change. Most people fail to consider whether altering these likes and dislikes is something anyone can practically achieve while alive. Then emerges the theory of scholars who chase after the poetic imagination which dictates that until 'Ra' changes, 'Ma' cannot be grasped. In order to demonstrate who was the greater scholar in the royal court of their respective times, if scholars competitively wrote and recited their works, the king did not necessarily need to comprehend south, north, east, or west. He merely needed to endorse it. The scholars have thus documented that all these accomplishments were brought about during this particular ruler's reign. With that, the matter was deemed settled.

Many such instances have occurred among us. Maha Vishnu, who trampled righteous rulers down to the netherworld (*Patala*) under the pretext that they lacked absolute decorum, was born here. If one asks why he was trampled into the netherworld in this manner, it is because he was classified as an Asura there. Thus, because he happened to be an Asura emperor, they instituted their law stipulating that he was not permitted to rule. Therefore, to establish that a Brahmin rules during that Sudra era within the Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Sudra systemic framework according to their laws, this individual had to be eliminated by fabricating a narrative about the emperor. However, the story propagated is highly illogical. Three paces of land were requested; when that was deemed insufficient, his head was also trampled down. You need not harbor any doubt that this is merely the logic of a poet. Just as it is narrated regarding Brahma, so too about Narada, or concerning numerous Brahmarakshasas, or in the accounts of countless angels, or certain celestial beings and the so-called djinns; by presenting various such accounts and leading humanity astray through literal interpretations, divine will must inevitably intervene at some point. Otherwise, by miscalculating the Manvantaras, it will be impossible to usher in a new Manvantara. Therefore, a resolution is only possible if a wealth of preceptorship (*Acharya Sampath*) emerges, capable of conveying to the people what must be contributed to the Manvantara and explaining why errors occurred within it.

The subsequent thought is regarding what kind of person that Acharya (preceptor) should be. This cannot be altered by an ordinary path of a Guru, or a path of renunciation (Sanyasa), or a minor prophetic path. Only someone who possesses a long-term vision spanning the duration of a Manvantara can change it. Such a long-term vision means understanding the past—how, after six Manvantaras, this came to be in the seventh Manvantara, where its cause lies, and what the reason behind that cause is; only a Mahatma capable of explaining this can set it right. This is because it is a mistake that occurred when a great soul of this Manvantara did the right thing. The fact is that there were no experienced individuals to hand over to us the perfect path of how to perform the right action. Speaking of experienced ones, there are modes of worship ranging from a deity and a demon up to numerous Brahmarakshasas. What has happened in the mode of worship, who all are involved in it, and if there is a duty to grant them birth or liberation by reaching their level in the matter of their existence, the Acharya can move forward only after fulfilling that. This is something that not many can achieve. However, reaching the position of what is called the virtue of the soul (Atmasukrutham)—of gods and goddesses—is also Atmasukrutham itself. After that, what are the positions of the Ganas, and what all Ganas are there—reaching their position is also possible only through Atmasukrutham. But beyond this, there is another state. When all these beings reach their respective places, they attain a celestial realm (Akashamandalam) commensurate with their position, according to their knowledge. That celestial realm, whether they call it the vast expanse (Vettaveli) or as mentioned in the verses of the Ishavasya Upanishad, extends even from such a pinnacle. It is not known how or in what manner one should be guided to that pinnacle. In this, when each demon and each deity appears, one must explain what was initially available for worship in the lineage of the primordial Manu (Aadimanuvu). After explaining that and accustoming them to it, corrections should be made at the stage involving gods, goddesses, sages (Rishis), and ascetics (Sanyasis). A disciple must grow to that level after this correction. There is a possibility that it could be a male or a female. What is that male and female? There are two divisions in that as well. If the male and female stand bound together, masculinity cannot be imparted to the female. For that, they themselves state a name—Napumsakam (gender-neutral). It cannot be given in that state either. Then, how many are the states of the Goddess, how many states exist from this demon to the deity, what are the transitional steps one passes through, and what that karma is—showing these to a disciple and having that disciple impart it to the higher realms of this world is the true aspect. Instead of that, if we go back to the written concepts of Manvantara and try to bring back the original nature of Manu, how do we correct the false narratives that portrayed him as the son of Brahma? Where is the Vedic knowledge located to reclaim the lineage of Manu alongside the lineage of the Trimurti? When viewed this way, numerous things will have to be corrected and rewritten. But this will not happen in one lifetime or even ten lifetimes. Then what is the use of setting out to do it? It is impossible. Then, based on what was seen, they bundled it up and created texts, created letters for the text, and created interpretations for the letters. Thus, assigning sound, form, and shape, they will arrive at an action embellished with ornaments in every note. This embellished action is what we artists call a musical concert. That is an ornamentation. The task is to assign sound, give form to that sound, merge into that form, give meaning to the sound that emerges from it—from within—and study it. Well, if all this could lead us to God, we would not have any other afflictions. It is our Mahatmas themselves who have proven that none of this is what is required. For that, many Gurus from the Parayi Petta Panthirukulam (the twelve clans born to the Pariah woman) and those raised in the Brahmin clan will write down the logic of the Brahmin. Those born in the clan of Shaivites will write down that Shaivism is everything. Otherwise, if one is a Shaktheyan, that is everything for them. These interpreters of letters have brought us to a point where we cannot know which is greater or which is smaller. We have become so corrupted that we are unable to show any sincerity of our own to move away from this. It is not our fault. We flowed along in a course of karma that respected the obstacles encountered along the path of passing times, without analyzing what those obstacles were. It will not be possible in one or two generations to correct this, rewrite it, and convince the people about the actual paths traversed by numerous figures who commonly appear among us now, such as Agastya, Bhogar, or others like Bhishma. People will repeatedly cling to the old and forget the story of the new again. This is a habituation we have been undergoing for so many ages.
Guruvani
February 2004

To evolve out of this familiarity like this, one cannot grow enough in a single lifetime. What is it? Having seen what the origin looks like, without showing in what all ways that origin has occurred, what the light of the times is, in which era I am writing this, for how long it should endure, and what the past times are, one cannot simply move forward. Thus, no one can put in the effort for this. Even if one puts in the effort, the truth cannot be known. When it happens like that, where no one can definitively say anything about anything, the Shaivite, the Shakta, and the Vaishnavite have only completed it from where they reached. Therefore, whatever anyone has said is complete. Then, if one states which of these is conducive to liberation, creating a story there in a confusing way with endless calculations for infinite times, creating a myth there, and behind that myth, having this mentioned king sign it, or having those emperors sign it, writing histories later for however long they ruled at that time, it becomes a practice of writing them down as being everything in this world. Devotees, if necessary, will impart a royal writing tradition to it and thus prepare an action that can be successfully passed off as being everything. So, for this action to be set right for you, ٹ or when our lives, each one of ours, reaches the religious doctrine of some prophet, evaluating where that prophet stands, where other gods and goddesses stand, where those who calculated and pondered over these stars, zodiac signs, and planets stand, where the Saptarshis who thought about it stand, how it is changed from there, identifying that due to this reason this went wrong, and now due to this reason, crafting the matter because of this and maintaining that action as the root of karma is the future liberation. So, at what all times can we correct it, that is the subsequent responsibility. All of those corrections will only happen in the Kali Yuga. Things entitled to the others still remain.

To accomplish all that is mentioned in the sections describing a Goddess, God, Sage, and Ascetic, there needs to be a visionary (deerghadarshi) who can reveal the karma required to unite the soul (jiva) and the supreme (param)—a karma meant for millions of souls who have arrived as the successors of thousands of states, having performed the associated karma and dharma and acquired that merit. Then, who, where, and how will one make such a visionary understand? This is the subsequent essence. Sometimes, individuals other than these renunciates attain all this. When non-renunciates attain this, a sense of triviality often creeps into them. Therefore, since we attained this through the approach of a Guru, what must we show the Guru in return for that compassion? The Guru is one who is born and performs karma across all eras; it is the disciple who must demonstrate how that person should be. That person (the Guru) must not merely state it. Because he (the disciple) must live and demonstrate it according to the words received. Thus, the disciple is the master of that course of karma which is lived and demonstrated. That disciple must similarly impart it to the people and to his contemporaries, and pass it on eternally as the wealth of the disciple. This is one path. Otherwise, there are some who leave, claiming they will reach God directly. The obstacle to reaching God directly is a certain knot that no one knows how to explain.

They are not Gurus who appear in every era. For that, they have been given certain names. By classifying them as Sage, Ascetic, Wise, Devotee, and Actor, and by correcting the rights and wrongs that arise from household duties, with that acquired merit, wherever they stand in the ethereal path, a disciple of the aforementioned Guru must stand there and show the succeeding generations what his Guru and he himself are, and elevate them. Thus, this specific karma cannot be seen at a mere glance. However, it is a state where certain scholars or visionaries have kept speaking, and ultimately, one cannot look back to see what their final karma was. The greatest evidence for this is Christianity, Islam, or the era of Moses. So, by narrating such stories, admitting defeat in all of them, reasoning beyond that, bringing it into elite scholarly logic and complicating it, it stands on a truth that has become so convoluted that no one can extract its essence. Therefore, one cannot even call it the truth. But is it not the truth? Will the elements present in all these karmas not be seen? They will be seen. But it is not like this; Sri Krishna is the greatest among those who came as the rightful heir to this Kali Yuga. After that, the next person who worked for it at least a little was able to approach it only because of a lack of erudition. Various stages were crossed and passed. Having passed them, this person did not know what all these states were. Then, he kept progressing according to what was taught. When he stood in such a formless state, it became impossible to discover the root cause of the many subjects identified as formless. Each of you must contemplate why that is so. If a visionary like Jesus says, "Let the rock split and move," it is definitively stated that it will move. Similarly, there have been times when people followed the doctrines of the God and Goddess and existed only under them. Those times cannot be bypassed either. What will be done then?

It is a specific power that can only be corrected in this Kali. Having demonstrated to the disciple how to implement dharma by performing the karma that is the cause of this Kali, and having observed how the disciple and Guru share it, it is that disciple who reveals the Guru to the world. Therefore, no matter how scholarly such a Guru lineage is, the objective will not be achieved. Vivekananda and numerous others, whoever has come to that plane, none of them will be able to achieve it. This specific karma cannot be accomplished. We require an acquaintance with this karma known as the soul's good deed (Atmasukrutam). In this Guru-disciple relationship, it is not a God and Goddess; where and into what will all these elements transform? Then, what all is contained in this bodily entity existing in the nature of the five senses; in which realm has it formed a base, taken shape, and positioned itself? It cannot be carried forward merely by grasping it as a tool in a karma hidden within the realms of creation, preservation, and destruction. Why is that? There is a place for that creation, preservation, and destruction. Upon reaching there, it changes, and the karma of proceeding into the realm within the Guru belongs to the visionary. That visionary should not speak to you by demonstrating miraculous powers. There should be no illusion or deceit; one must live with the meaning of carrying it forward in every way as the path shown by God. But while living like that, one thing is necessary. We are born today in the era known as Kali. It was mentioned earlier that Kali has a dharma. Not knowing what must happen in that Kali-dharma, we have created a veil using Puranas, epics, and histories to such an extent that we consider Kali to be evil and are unable to grasp what the foundational karma of Kali is. When we say a veil, it also implies the Vedas. So, when reading the Puranas and epics of these Vedas, one wanders into this forest and can never find a way out of it. So, it is not possible here either. Then where is it possible?

There is a guiding principle that says, "Great sages praise what they see on that very day." So, what was done in the dharma of this Kali, what was done in the Chatur Yuga that preceded it, how many karmas have been flawed over countless ages in that Chatur Yuga; in that karma, the foundation of dharma is created there, united with the purusha bearing that karma, by the Guru who says "our lineage and us," or the soul with that personality in the position of the Guru. This can be called creation, preservation, and destruction. But it is impossible to enter and proceed into such matters without someone's help. That is why it is said in many ways that the Guru is Brahma, the Guru is Vishnu, and the Guru is Shiva. So, when this is said in many ways, God is in everything. Then what is the essence! He is in the atom and in the infinite. Thus, the God residing in the atom and the God residing in the infinite are one and the same. Therefore, if seen in the size of an atom, that is enough for me. If seen in the size of a great infinite, that is enough for him. If not, and if seen in the entirety of a sphere, it is complete for him. So, as this passes by, we have degraded to such an extent that we cannot present our own doctrine there, and instead, we act out our karma and perish, confined to the history of an archer-hero of karma who operates by forsaking all love and respect.

March 2004

If this is not to be lost to you, you must attain a Guru before whom your gods, goddesses, sages, ascetics, the wise, devotees, all the seers of the past, and all the prophets who have come thus far, can stand and say, "My work is only up to this point; I entrust it to you, please complete it." Coming as a visionary, it is a great remainder of karma that can observe what happened in these three mentioned times. A great karmic remainder it is. Having observed that, it should guide you through it. So, such a Guru, if you get one, how will you recognize them, and how will you not recognize them — unless you understand this and move forward, the misfortune of none of you being able to find or accomplish this will remain there like objects sunk in the mud that cannot be lifted up. Then, in some era, by God's will, it must rise up and attain an eternal state in such a way. Therefore, all of this is being explained to you in a way that you can see it with your own eyes. Thus, regarding how we should accomplish this, that path of action is absolutely represented by the Guru. That Guru and how they should be is what the disciple must understand. So, that disciple, having seen these three mentioned times — past, future, and present — that disciple'sٹ wealth of discipleship will turn around. ٹ Having gone like that and returned from it, only an heir of Jivanmukti can show you this path. Otherwise, no matter how much of a Siddha, or how great a Jnani, or how great a Bhakta one claims to be, it is of no use. This right, without obtaining it from Brahman or from one's chosen karma, cannot be exercised by anyone. Therefore, as much as possible, you must understand the importance of this Guru-disciple relationship and what happens when this Guru and disciple unite, and act accordingly. God has given us a medium to do this. Because men and women bear witness to that medium, regarding where and how it should be taken from now on, the largest chain of a beginning is what we have initiated. Now, until that chain is completed, there will be advancements and retreats where no one can do anything. You should think for yourselves whether we need to change this or not. An opportunity to change this, that is Kali. In that Kali, where it is said that everyone can attain Brahmajnana, because this Chandala, Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra do not unite, work together, and complete their lives, everything has been lost through chanting and taking in turns. But in that manner, you cannot proceed anymore. That is why you must hold on to a Guru. When saying Guru — what is it? Each of you must comprehend this individually; before embarking on your familial life, you must initiate a process to determine what needs to be resolved. To perfect this through repeated practice, and for the sake of our traditional growth and foundational stability, it requires unraveling a vast sphere of action (*karmakanda*) bestowed by God. This alone will suffice to meet the requirements of all of you, as well as these youngsters here who have donned the attire of ascetics.

If you say, "Let it be after this *Kali* (Kaliyuga) passes," you will not get time after *Kali* ends; neither your ancestors got it, nor will the future generations get it. Therefore, a Guru must instruct you to understand the *dharma* (righteous duty) of *Kali* and guide you along that path. That is your greatest wealth. Instead, God is not tied behind the supernatural powers of some other god, goddess, sage, ascetic, or wise man showing off nonsensical asceticism—this is not to say that. The path to attain God must be received from our Guru. This Guru might emerge as the Guru of the world. If four or five such lineages of Gurus are brought together to function unitedly, this will never fail. You should not believe that it will cease to exist either. Therefore, what do we need? What is meant by this path of karma and the path of virtue? Having understood all this, it is said that there is no way for us other than through a soul (*jivatma*) that has acquired this virtue. If all of you do not handle this with this understanding, what I do is completely futile, an absolute waste of labor. It will culminate as the most severe waste of effort. So, that must not happen. You should not present or preach about any such demons, gods, goddesses, outcasts (*chandalas*), or idols to anyone. Only then will this progress. Thus, I have explained this to you as an introduction to conducting the *Guru Puja* (worship of the Guru) here.
Guruvani
April 2004

Therefore, having understood this, you must perform *Guru Puja* to the best of your abilities—achieving purity of the deities (*deva shuddhi*), sages (*rishi shuddhi*), and ancestors (*pitru shuddhi*)—as this Guru lineage transforms and brings about a paradigm shift in the traditional methods of worship that have existed hitherto. There is no trace of the path of any other previously existing Guru lineages in this. Neither does it contain the path of any other preceptor (*acharya*). This is an independent endeavor that absorbs the entirety of the objectives of the preceptors up to this point, transfers all these rituals into our midst, and ensures that these children or that lineage become instrumental in a manner beneficial to the knowers of Brahman (*Brahmajnanis*). This is the underlying vision. In alignment with this vision, even if only mentally, you should invoke God, or if all of you are physically able and willing, everyone should go and circumambulate the place of worship to the right and chant the continuous divine name (*akhandanama*) for a while. Everyone should chant internally. Having informed that everyone must do this: on one hand, there are ritualistic injunctions that are unbearably burdensome. On the other hand, there is a situation where there is absolutely no one to properly explain the practices that can be adopted. Thus, after the *Yuga Dharmas* (duties of the epochs) themselves have passed in myriad ways, the epoch that provides us with the correction for all this, affording us an opportunity to act by recognizing the mistakes or validities that occurred in all previous epochs—the *Satyayuga*, *Tretayuga*, and *Dvaparayuga*—is the *Kaliyuga*. However, we have been conditioned to believe that this *Kaliyuga* is worthless. Since *Kali* is considered worthless, there are those who even think there is no point in paying much attention to it. We must not evaluate it as worthless. By critically examining the rights and wrongs that have occurred up to this day concerning *Kali*, this *Kaliyuga* serves as a preparatory phase that imparts the knowledge of what must and must not be done to usher the departure toward the next *Satyayuga* into the midst of the masses. We require an awareness of such a *Kaliyuga*, where we are informed even of the errors and granted the opportunity to rectify them. Otherwise, our experience is one of clinging to some mythologies or epics in some way, wasting our lives without any attainment in this field of action, and living a life discarding action, oblivious to its true nature. Why is this so?

The advent of an enlightened being (*jnani*) like Sri Krishna shortly before the commencement of this *Kali* is the greatest testament for this *Shudra* class. Because, prior to that, there was a time when kings ruled as our spiritual preceptors (*Desikas*). Consequently, in accordance with the *dharma* of that epoch, as the author of the Gita states, "Pratyakshavagamam dharmam" (dharma directly experienced), these kings would stand manifest and instruct upon each of these dharmas. However, moving forward from the era of Sri Krishna, that divine resolve (*Brahmanischaya*) had been prepared for us long before, sending many individuals in multiple phases. We failed to discover this within the dharma of our India. The reason for this is our karmic trajectory, wherein we cling to obsolete customs and act upon them, rather than rectifying and internalizing the worship practices of the aforementioned four epochs (*Chaturyugas*). Although it continued in that manner until Sri Krishna's birth, it is said that an ethereal voice (*ashariri*) was given to Kamsa even before the birth. Yet, the greatness of this ethereal voice was never articulated or grasped. What happened as a result? Kamsa was portrayed and presented in a way that makes us declare him evil. But Kamsa was not evil: How? He was merely abiding by his own *dharma*. What was the nature of that *dharma*? This directly perceivable *dharma*, where gods and goddesses manifest and instruct on what must and must not be done, constitutes that matter. So, under these circumstances, upon receiving this ethereal voice, it becomes unbelievable. This is because none of the knowledge of the past ancestors aligns with the dictates of this ethereal voice. So, what does this ethereal voice proclaim? "Rule by looking downwards, not upwards." Since this system of governance did not operate in a single language, the tragedy wherein individuals governed and facilitated governance according to their own convenience in numerous languages across India—lacking the ability to comprehend and act according to the *Yuga Dharmas*, or a situation where the king attains a sage-like status but fails to transmit that wisdom back to the populace—has been persisting across numerous cycles of *Chaturyugas*.

But with the determination to resolve this, this mistake ending, and at the same time people coming together and growing to become knowing what the dharma of the next Satyayuga is, it was to transform into such people that Sri Krishna was made to take birth. But Sri Krishna was born a Jnani (wise one) from birth itself. But this action of being a born Jnani remained unknown to this Shudra class. Now, when saying Shudra class, you might assume it is a caste; it is not a caste. It is a Varna. We all belong to the Shudra class. A prescribed karma is arranged here regarding how a Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra should behave. But converting all those karmas as each one's own entitlement, that karma went on in a way that Dharma could not sustain. We got caught in a trap where it could never be practiced, and each of us moved behind those scrambling to copy the baseness that shows the pride of inter-yuga dharma. What happened to us because of this? We lack self-knowledge. We did not know that we went towards information where others' knowledge destroys us ourselves. Then again from the time of Sri Krishna, ٹ despite Sri Krishna being such a great person, the status attained by that birth, unable to cross over from it due to the ignorance of our people, for a long time, ڊ that acquaintance from the day of birth - is a news of sorrow. Because, the royal family had the misfortune of having to beat to death all seven babies born before him. All this is due to the inability to follow the word received from the divine voice (Ashariri). What is this Ashariri? It means 'do not look upwards'. So, do not rule by looking at emperors, do not rule by looking at past kings either, look at what your Dharma is today - that is what the Ashariri meant. But since this was not a familiar subject as far as Kamsa was concerned, he maintained the scenario that was heard and made to be heard from these gods and goddesses. That is why we did not get good information about Sri Krishna. However, even after this, many gurus or prophets and their subsequent successors who grew up, all of them had the misfortune of having to hide behind this mistake. Those who tried to correct this were Nabi and Sri Krishna. But it was not corrected. The reason for that is, since it was not an elevated society, what they said could not be corrected and understood. For this reason, all of us, having been caught up across ages and known as the remainder of the fault in actions, we are taking birth in Kali Yuga to rectify it. But we do not know this. So what happened?

Can we proceed by speaking a truth that belonged to the Satya Yuga? This is the Kali Yuga. Similarly, can we step down and act by speaking of the karmas of the Treta Yuga and Dwapara Yuga? That is also not possible. However, what we need are multitudes of Gurus who can show and explain to us the course of karma that has been worshipped up to this day. But we do not know this either. What have we heard and kept in mind? Rejecting everything, absolutely everything. We only have the experience of hiding behind numerous Tantric and Yantric procedures that show 'Swaha' by saying either 'Shivoham' or 'Swaha'. But the advent of Sri Krishna was to bring a change to this. After that, in India itself, Buddha and his lineage, the Sikhs, the Jains, and similarly numerous Gurus have come. But since we lacked the knowledge to reclaim any of this, we went back to the old ways themselves. We did not get the path corrected by Krishna either. We are just standing in the ignorance shown by the authors of the Gita or those who preach the Gita, who merely speak of the power of penance of the long history of the Treta Yuga. Then, can we actually acquire this knowledge? No. Then what is it? Can this enter into the householders? Nor that. Then what is it? Tangled in these demonstrated Tantric and Yantric procedures, we have only been able to create humans capable of sowing the destruction of this country. Then you may ask in a way. What is it? Is God that bad? The meaning of what has been said is that He is not bad. Why? The things known about the past times should not be denied. The first step to bring you to an experience of knowing it, having denied it, and then acquiring knowledge, was already laid at the beginning of this Kali Yuga. After this, Moses, as well as Jesus and the Prophet, came. Although they also spoke of the prophetic path, it would be correct to say that even today, we do not actually know what this prophethood is. Because we, the people at the very bottom, desperately changed religions and followed unfamiliar paths, adopting an ignorant path that showed great arrogance, and thus the path of truth was closed. So in this state, we are in a position where we cannot do anything at all. We just need to look from the beginning of this Satya Yuga. If we look beyond that, there is an incomprehensible karma. Then, only a hint of it can be given to you. Otherwise, it is not a karma that you should look at, mechanize, and formulate. Having completely understood the sense of defeat, how can we overcome this defeat? This is our thought today. To give us the authority for this thought, God's grace—as if brought along and given to all of us—gave birth to Mahatmas in all parts and all countries in this way. But none of this made us give up the customary rituals of our ancestors. Not only that, we neither saw nor knew what these ancestors practiced and what flaws existed in them. We too merely performed what someone else had shown. We had nothing beyond this. Because of this, even though numerous Mahatmas like Sri Krishna came, we could not revere and accept them. After it came to be like that, what this aforementioned prophetic religion demonstrated was whether a custom could be changed in any way. But even there, only the ignorant poor mingled and melted into it, with tantras, yantras, and literal knowledge of that nature. Having gone there and taken over the monopolistic nature of this foreign path, becoming fragments of an action we perform, what are a bunch of directionless and stubbornly ignorant people showing today? Siddhi; when that Siddhi is mentioned, you think it means Jnana (wisdom). If asked, "Isn't he a Siddha?", the meaning of your question is that he is a Jnani. Since even the knowledge that Siddhi and Jnana are two different things is lacking among us, we ask like this: "Is he a Siddha?" So, if we are led to a karma that brings achieved powers (Siddhis) to astound and instruct us, how will this old karma go away? Or is it that what our people practiced was nothing; and if it was something, how can it be changed? After this, having changed it, in what should we act to move forward? Until today, none of those who spoke within India have mentioned this path.

If they feel this mischief is a complete failure, they will take up another mischief. Other than that, regarding them, they have no governance or a path of action as an administrator. Someone without that is unlikely to get dharma either. Dharma - we are all the remainder of the ignorance that sits at the bottom of one without dharma and calls out. So, if we unravel the scroll of this course of action standing as this remainder and fate, we have absolutely no courtesy to interact with each other. Then, some have invented a new policy. What it is, is to help others. He is one who does immense help. So, if he earns ten or two hundred dollars working for a month, taking only what he needs to survive, they say he is helping his friends. Seeing and learning this, the children growing up next door have also become this base. Spreading to this country, such help and cooperation are being invented. What won't the children of family people who have taken up these fragments of karma, turning into this hostel and hotel that extract money by manifesting the suitable five-star hotel and the dark rooms attached to it, do in this country! None of this being possible to do, the children of mischievous people who eat away at the country come like this, and not only in this country, but in the world, rejecting whatever human life there is, we fail to understand that the Vedanta outside the culvert and the imagination of the disastrous minions who stand at the door of the paan shop and pose as swamis are completely the full form of a nature devoid of dharma and karma. Without understanding this, a form they build up the biggest form of revenge that each idol of ignorance created by religious groups that create caste, calling every Pillai Swami like Pillai Swami and Damodaran Pillai Swami in a way that makes known it's a certain caste, can do to us while living. Seeing this, if it is enough for all this to grow in your house as well, there is no need for you to come here. That exists all over the land.
