Until today, it is not just holding tightly onto the doctrines of the gods and goddesses worshipped or the lineage of sages or the lineage of Manus that have passed by. All this does exist. For this - for this reality we now see before us - what change must be brought about, the householders who show it through their lives and the children who follow them - not only for the world and the home, but wherever humanity or living creatures exist, for each of you to feel that our children should be the ones to adopt a life that earns merit for all of them, or to desire and act upon it, the traditional path to set out to the Satya Yuga by clearing all available paths and removing the disasters for that path, is what is needed in today's people, and not only that, stepping away from today's Vedanta verses, Advaita - is a very good thing, true - but is this Advaita good for you or anyone else to swallow? If swallowed, where will you go and stand? With whom will you stand? Even this is unknown. All are dualities. All are illusions. You must think about what these empty scholars are doing to you by spouting this illusory nonsense and grabbing money and similar positions from you. If said, this is not something that can be said to please you.

The intellectual prowess of these scholars lies in laying a mat of rationalization for this injustice that has grown to this day. How will you come forward in this state? Will this change if some salvationist, rationalist, or hedonist comes along? Knowing specifically that this is a realization to be imbibed into your absolute karmic path, each one of you—or rather, each one of us—is a path of Dharma meant to take up the duty that needs to be undertaken, perform it, maintain righteousness, impart the light of great epochs to your children, and pass on the right to inherit that light to generations yet to be born. The knowledge imparted from here is meant to let you introspect on what you are doing for this. I will not take or use even a single word from any person, or a Swami, or anyone else. I have left them to their own devices. As far as I am concerned, this exists, and it is true. There is truth in what they said too. But how will you accept it practically like alms in your palms? Or how will you imbibe it into your hearts and transform yourselves into individuals with a sense of justice? We have lost our rhythm in this familiarity. What is being imparted from here is a karmic path that every householder and every individual must strive to achieve in order to gain the respect of an action that can be understood and transformed by you. If you do not preserve this, not only is there no practical utility in stating these things, but it also leads us to an action that pawns and destroys ourselves. To prevent this, there is no point in allowing the Trinity system of bygone eras, or the tribal system, or the writings filled with Puranas, Epics, and Aranyakas to spread into you. None of these will result in anything other than leading you into a moral dilemma that ensnares your soul. Due to this lack of knowledge, we could not even completely fulfill the greatest karmic chapter we undertook. And it will not happen that way either. Because we are talking about something that happened ten trillion years ago. Therefore, we cannot go back that far to retrieve it. Hence, you do not need to go and retrieve any of that. Just acknowledge that these things exist. Having seen them, let today's necessity become tomorrow's truth. Every one of you must be able to understand that the purpose and the realization of the goal of Santhigiri, which has been imparted to us as God, is a consciousness of Dharma carried out with the sole desire of familiarizing you with these paths so that you can perfect and practice them, and you must be able to contemplate what needs to be done about this.
Guruvani
June 2004

I mentioned a few things about the greatness of sacrifice last time. However, what I have to say does not end with that. There are many things I have gained from experience and understood by seeing and hearing. I possess an immense enthusiasm to impart all these to you, one by one. Only then do I feel you will gain at least some understanding of its true essence.

No matter how agonizing the problems I faced were, I attempted to resolve them while maintaining utmost equanimity. As a result, my problems were resolved. I can definitively state that there has never been an occasion where they were not resolved. To be more precise, I grew up in a desert. I did not collapse in its terrible heat. Gathering strength, I moved forward moment by moment. If I had felt a slight mental distress and abandoned everything back then, I would have reached nowhere today. I would have been destroyed, entangled in the complexities of my own problems. Regardless, I do not know how I was able to gather such internal strength during those days.

Many well-wishers, observing my actions, have offered various pieces of advice. They have tried to dissuade me from many endeavors. However, while listening to all their advice, I proceeded strictly along my own path. I wish to clarify one thing here. We should not alienate anyone. They might be saying such things with good intentions. However, it is absolutely essential for success in life that we accept the positive aspects of what they say and strive to find our own path. We may not achieve its results very quickly. Even so, there is no doubt that the results will be attained in due course.

I began by speaking about sacrifice. All the righteous individuals who have existed in the world have achieved sacrifice through their actions. Only they have been able to accomplish anything eternal here. Look at the lives of great souls like Jesus Christ, Prophet Muhammad, and Buddha. One can find a great mountain of sacrifice there. Moreover, were those lives not the very embodiment of sacrifice? You do not need to look elsewhere. Just look at Mahatma Gandhi, who shines as the apple of our India's eye; how magnificent is the message imparted by that life, which evolved through the greatness of sacrifice. Was he not able to bring a great power, which ruled over a vast nation, to its knees with the mere message of peace? I do not think anything like that has happened anywhere else in the world. I also do not think such greatness could be achieved by anyone other than someone from India. Indians are people who have traversed through that much tolerance and tradition. Their life is one of friendship and peace. No power in the world has been able to surpass that.

In every era, great souls have taken birth in this land of India. Through their powerful sacrifices, they have bestowed vitality and life upon the entire human race. We must understand this clearly. Only that has survived. And only that will continue to survive. Another great soul who created change to a certain extent through sacrifice is Sree Narayana Guru. After Sree Sankara Bhagavatpada, it is difficult to find another Karma Yogi who has brought about such a massive social revolution in our India. Appropriate value must be assigned to his life, which was elevated by sacrifice. If we practice such sacrifice, or if we cultivate a discipline rich in sacrifice, there is no greater service than that. It is not mandatory that we should rise to the level of those great souls from that. Their sacrifice attained a great stature. Therefore, we should not be bewildered by the thought that we cannot even peek into that realm. They reached that supreme position through their relentless effort and readiness. We do not have to turn back thinking about that. If we try to move at least a little within that richness of sacrifice, we will receive its respective results. The magnitude of it will only be received in proportion to that sacrifice. Even so, there is no doubt that it will indeed result in a successful life.

Then there is another side to it. Let it be said that it is somewhat spiritual. It concerns the course of our karma. Some people do not advance no matter how hard they try, while others reach their desired positions with very little effort. What is the reason for this? We can see many people feeling distressed contemplating this. One thing can be pointed out in this regard: the variations in karma. One group of people strives in a state where the karmas or sacrifices performed in past lives are eager for completion. Consequently, they achieve results very quickly. For others, the course of karma may not have been completed in their previous lives. There, this course of karma can only be fulfilled through sacrifice. If we consider the reason for someone rising to great heights, it is because that person's current life is destined for it. They might have completed all its aspects by making sacrifices in their past lives. For such individuals, only a little effort is required to achieve their goals. Therefore, one must remember that the elevated position currently attained is the aftermath of good deeds practiced over multiple lifetimes.

The courses of karma across lifetimes manifest in various ways. Many do not seem to believe in this. It is good for us to remember one thing: if we isolate and analyze the various trajectories of life, we will become convinced of that absolute truth. Many are forced to lead different kinds of lives. A blind child is born into the home of a wealthy person, while in some places, children are born with deformed limbs. We must observe and pay attention to all of this. What are these phenomena? Are they not the resurrections of the cursed aspects of past lives? How can we choose not to believe these things? Thus, it follows that the base actions and good deeds of past lives continue to follow us. There are many reasons why we emphasize this, and it is certainly something others should ponder.
Now, let me say a little about the general life of human beings!

When a human being becomes sorrowful, forgetting everything, he wanders in search of refuge. In prosperity, he forgets everything. That is a general characteristic. However, he must be able to cultivate a presence of mind that remains unshaken and unwavering in the face of anything. To achieve this, he needs to remember the controller of this universe and act with that awareness. Only then will sacrifice emerge within him, and only then will it attain a permanent state!

All the great sacrificers the world has seen today are those who have worked incessantly, standing behind that power. We can all clearly understand what they have achieved as a result. People continue to follow their path and find solace in it. Thus, their words inspire us to lead a fulfilling life.

I have mentioned the life of Jesus Christ earlier. Did he not sacrifice his very life for the sake of sacrifice? What could be greater than that? Even in his final moments, he said, "Father! Forgive them, for they know not what they do." Do not the words of that great figure, who highlighted such greatness by offering his own life, resonate everywhere even today? The case of the great Buddha is no different. Is he not the noble soul who renounced all the royal comforts of this world and set forth for the welfare of the people? Who can claim the magnificence of that sacrifice? How monumental his achievements have become! Thus, it can be seen that all the great souls who achieved immortality in life were the very embodiments of sacrifice.

Here, such sacrifice is also necessary for the foundation of our material life. If we wish to initiate any movement, we must make sacrifices for it as well. The success of that institution will correspond to the extent of those sacrifices. If we examine the lives of many who have risen to prominence today, we can understand this fact. But if the seeds of ego take root in their thought process, we witness the destruction not only of the individual but also of the movement they have built. Therefore, as we progress towards a goal through sacrifice, we must acquire all the relevant knowledge. What is that knowledge? What purpose does it serve? Ego dwells within the human mind. Hence, the primary requirement is the eradication of ignorance, which alone will lead to success. What is required for this? We must understand the life perspectives of great figures, reflect upon them, and subsequently strive to put them into practice. If we proceed step-by-step in this manner, we can reach our intended destination. Such a systematic life is, in itself, a form of sacrifice, and it is for this that we must strive. Perhaps many of you would like to know the benefits of doing so. First is the liberation from our karmic bonds, which facilitates merging with the Divine. The second is contentment in life. We shall attain both of these, leading us to the unearthly, supreme state. What more does a human life require than this?
Guruvani
September 2004

We could not understand Sri Krishna who was born as a wise man. It has been covered with stories and turned into the most wicked stories, transformed into stories and plays, making it Kathakali or all the bad things like dramas, showing and informing us that this is our special intelligence today, how much can we achieve in this action? When we look at each of these things in this way, God has been working for us for so long. But we have never understood this. Then you might ask, it is said that God is everything - then why not just overturn it with a single flip. It is not right. For how many ages - even when you hear the word Kalpa - look at it according to that calculation itself. It is talking about a story of a Kalpa that has been inactive for so long or active for so long, which has come as so many Chaturyugas or so many Manvantaras. Can we go straight by studying all this? We cannot. Then what should we do? If a prophet coming according to the times or an Acharya or any such Mahatma comes, how will we know about this person? We cannot know in any way. This is exactly what happened in everyone's history. This Chaturyuga is a very short period for us. How? Because Kali has just started. Then how can we, who cannot even take and see just three periods, know this long history about this Chaturyuga? Because we have no information about anything like this, whoever said calculations wherever, they came with calculations keeping everything written down as one. Then how were these historians able to give calculations this long? It will not work out for them. That is why, even if told very clearly by extending and shortening it, it is a story that does not go beyond ten thousand years. Even if we look with the knowledge we have heard and kept now? We don't have to look at anyone else's. After Sri Krishna was born, the Mahatmas who have come till today have tried to improve us by talking, being born and making others be born in very low categories and all other categories. But nobody understood this. Also, nobody knows who this is. When it came in that way, each of us fell and rotted in an action course where nobody respects anything, and it became like taking and scooping up rubbish without its goodness (after draining the essence). In that state, we have become bad. How can we correct this? It will only work if some Mahatma tells you. No other individuals can say anything. Except for whichever individual has received a right for the times, that person alone can correct you. How will we understand that correcting person? How will you understand that it is true? We are each the remainder of what has turned into numerous evil seeds that we ourselves have committed so as not to become good, as the actions you have come to hear, see, know, worship and make others worship have reached the most wicked state. How can we become good? Through what will we become good? We do not even know this action. Then how do our mother and father make us hear? A god in my houseٹ . On the contrary, you are seeing a history in recent times - of this Pandyan king. About Pandyan's wife, it is said about her, it is described in the same way in that story too. This Pandyan's alliance is from Kanchipuram. So there are great carvings and all such things in Kanchipuram.

But in reality, the wealth of knowledge of this city is very immense. Agreed. Suppose it is the greatest thing for our country or otherwise. How do we understand this? Because it is said that the one who married and brought this woman built temples in many ways. Thus, when it came to the act concerning their beloved deity, this Pandyan king built the Madurai Meenakshi temple, and when it was properly completed, he asked this woman, "Now, who is greater: your father or me?" She replied that he was not even as big as one pillar of her father's. He cut that down, sculpted the woman and him together, and placed it there. How do we know history through this? Because so many such fabricated stories and lack of historical truths have misled us, we have no knowledge about anything. With that happening, a discourse arose for our caste. How did it first originate? If we need to cut and dig the earth, we have to invent an iron tool, and only after that can we do all this. So, when our people look at it, how long ago was this iron tool invented? They talk as if it was found somewhere just yesterday. If so, how did cutting and digging the earth and all this happen? Therefore, they talked us into this, deceived us, and ruined us. This is not the story of one Chaturyuga or two Chaturyugas. The story we see today is the remnant of thousands of Chaturyugas. It has been covered up, hidden, and fallen apart at times. All that will undergo many changes according to the coming times. But this is not what we need to understand about ourselves. We must understand exactly how our ancestors lived, know the sad stories of their lives, and then we must definitely find a special dharma to work for their welfare and ours. Because we lack this special sense of dharma, we have no knowledge about karma. Then what happened? We all jump around together in all the frenzy shown by these caste oracles, and you and I compete to show that your frenzy is greater than mine. Other than this, is there any truth to be told in this? If anyone has, they can say it. Some stories were also written fabricating this as God. And now, they are writing stories for some family temples! They are writing about this Devi temple. They write and bring a Devi Purana and fabricate it. Thus, the god of our family becomes the god of the entire world. Even today, there are historians who write like this.

We celebrated the magnitude of the malpractices we each engage in, trapped in the mistakes that occurred due to our ignorant methods of worship. What if this ignorance, which is shown as a special rule, is written down and taught! It is the fault that each of our children is not growing up in that proper manner. What happened because of that? Caste came and became the lord, class hatred arose, and in every way, talking about lord, boss, and slave, what we hold in our hands is the harvest of the fortress of destruction that was sown. If we say that all this happened by God's will, how can we deal with it? Why is this said in brief? It is about where we stand in the act of worshiping and making others worship today. So, when everyone talks about the worship of God in their religion, their God stands as the greatest ancient creator. Similarly, if we speak of each caste, our caste is the greatest. And these lower castes do not even have a God. What to do? As a result of building slavery in this way, we do not know how to worship God or worship the greatest entity. This is the truth. Therefore, if we want to worship God, this is not enough. If we don't even have the interest to learn this, what will we do? So, having understood this, we need an introduction to know what God is, what a Deva is, what a Devi is, what a Rishi is, what a Sanyasi is, what a Jnani is, what a Bhakta is, and what a Karmi is. Can we introduce you to all this and lead you straight? If anyone has a story of being able to do so, you tell. Why were we ruined by being made to believe all this? The good knowledge that existed in our country, which you believe to be good, is gone from here because of acquiring knowledge in a vile manner by learning and teaching Puranas, their related writings, and their logic, in such a way that we do not get the convenience to think about any of this. That can only be said by those of you who have studied. Not me. I am an uneducated person. You tell stories just to say that the first university was in India. But by telling this story, what do you know about the things that originated in India? Looking at all parts of the land like that, aren't each of us the remnant of a wretched knowledge where we cannot see anything? What should we do about this? This is the karma we see before us, which your contemporaries think and know, or get liberated and know. We can only think and know that and learn the rest of it, but we cannot move forward knowing everything. If anyone assumes that they know so, it is simply in vain. Because we did not understand it that way, we drifted away from the act of writing and preserving these various kinds of knowledge, and this goodness became very low for us. This cannot be done by a historian or a person born only for a Yuga Dharma. Then how do we know this? The reason for saying "only for Yuga Dharma" is, having at least known what the Dharma of this Kali Yuga is, who are each of us in the act of alleviating this Kali? What is the reason for us having this knowledge? How will we reach that cause and effect? How can we handle this without reaching this sense of Dharma? When questioned like this, we are nowhere. We do not belong to anyone. We are nobody. Holding on to the bottom of the historical truth that has degraded in this way, if we boast, where will each of us be? If the era that teaches that the time when this writing, which is called the greatest history, emerged is only this much, then what is the Dharma that knows about this Yuga Dharma or knows about this Chaturyuga? How will we reclaim this Chaturyuga? Having taken that, how will we explain the Dharma of the Kali Yuga happening in this fourth quarter to the children? If asked whether any other ignorant caste like us has been born in the world, the answer is no. We have not acquired knowledge in this manner. We have no idea about this because we simply lived following someone and rallied behind the custodian who brought it into education. What is it now? I mentioned logic (Tarkashastra). The activities that create our war materials seen today were grasped from this Nyayashastra. If this is in India, which tells where the measurements of the Vimana were, we need to know why that India could not take this. This went to many places like this, and today they are selling it and making money. Furthermore, it is a truth that Indians do not have the capability to make any good thing, even the wire of a good pin. What are you forgetting? So, having been degraded to this level by a government and historical truth capable of bringing us down, what have we been able to do? Other than fighting amongst ourselves, have we been able to impart any goodness to this, to date? As a father and mother, how can we teach a karma to impart to our brothers and sisters and to respect the truth for our children to live? Each one of us is born at the root of such dead, degraded ignorance. God has given you an opportunity to think about what each of you can do to change this.
Guruvani
October 2004

Each of us needs this qualification. Our children absolutely need it. We are completely ignorant about what we must do to achieve this. If we are to eradicate the karma that has accumulated in us over countless periods due to this ignorance, it is impossible except through these children. Therefore, unless each of us moves forward on a path where we attain the knowledge, experience, and familiarity to handle this properly, at least for the sake of the children, we will be forced into a situation where God will never forgive us. The reason for this is that, through our lives and the hardships we have endured, or due to the various tendencies aimed at destroying someone, we have reached a stage where we make offerings and sacrifices, trying to get things done by giving something to God for everything. Having reached such an alien nature, we ourselves are doing it in a way that brings harm upon us.

Each of you must know and make others know whether we can bring about any change in this, and if so, what it should be. We must also preserve that knowledge without allowing any errors to creep into it. To preserve it, we ourselves must possess intrinsic knowledge. We cannot accomplish any of this merely by practically understanding the traditional knowledge that shows us what our life is, and by acquiring all the understanding required to discern right from wrong within it. That is not what is being said. We must focus only on how much knowledge we could acquire during our lifetime, the errors in what we have acquired, and foresee the mistakes that may occur in the future, realizing that this mistake is not only in our hands but in the hands of the entire world. It is exceedingly difficult for us to remove this from the grasp of the world. Now we are all sitting together like this. This has already become an imprint of nature. Based on this present state, which has been imprinted over many periods, and the karma that is going to unfold in relation to the past and the future, where do we stand? We should only think about how we must handle this henceforth. In this regard, God has given us sufficient evidence to understand it concisely and to gain immense knowledge from that brevity.

That is to say, our ancestors have been performing certain acts for ages; they did so with good intentions, but we suffer from the misfortune of not being able to distinguish whether it is good or bad. This is because we, as well as our ancestors, have been unable to investigate and discover where we stand today, having unconsciously deviated by doing many things in the name of worship, driven by the catastrophe of worship that has been practiced and propagated until now. With this sorrowful realization, will we receive an ordained karma regarding how to accomplish this or not? If we do, we cannot look back at the myriad ages of past errors that we must traditionally preserve and correct. Then what is needed? Even among those who know something—such as palmistry or the various aspects associated with our horoscopes—there are countless people who remain ignorant of this. What is known is little, and when we look at what is known, we are standing at ground zero. Why?

Our ancestors have departed and are wandering in the karma of worship we have been practicing. It is not just us; when we say our ancestors, it is not enough to mention two or four generations. Having seen a great light of countless bygone eras, and witnessing what destructions have been sown as seeds within this light, how will we uproot and remove them? That is our concern. It is not enough for us or our country; we are entirely heading towards a karma that strengthens evil thoughts, having grown and spread to all parts of the world, standing firmly and powerfully poised for this battle. Seeing this, do we or our children have the time for anything other than challenging it or taking a form of retaliation against it?

We do not have time to look after our own affairs. Therefore, we must move away from this karmic dosha where cause and effect have become entangled. There is only one way for us to do this. As mentioned earlier, if we proceed by discussing Yoga, Karma, Jnana, and Bhakti, our lifespan is insufficient even to reach that stage. Or else, what can be achieved through our lives? It is not that either, then what is it? Our children must step into the karma of untying the imprint that nature stamps upon them—an imprint that has remained fixed for ages, coming to them as a result of the karma we undertake throughout our lifetimes and its consequences. Instead of questioning how to untie it or whether to untie it, you should not become exhausted by overthinking it.

Why? This is not something that can be resolved by mere thought. As long as we remain in complete ignorance regarding all this, we cannot comprehend it through thinking. But we can do one thing. Give priority to our children, proceeding with the determination, love, and respect that at least our children should be able to perfectly fulfill what God has ordained for each of us. Giving that priority means acknowledging that God has given us the knowledge to alter the karma performed by our ancestors. You are more or less aware of this. If any of our children reaches this state—existing within this interplanetary realm—think of the sphere of influence of countless planets under which our Earth, Moon, or Sun operates together in a karmic process! Only if we have conviction in this karma can we realize the harmful thoughts we have harbored because of it and understand that we must change from it. Unless we prepare a background of good knowledge regarding what this change is—a process that involves feeling pain and causing pain—we need capable children who can take on whatever comes to us or to this era, be it destruction or good, bad or evil. We cannot fully take it on ourselves. Nor can we completely reject it; we have acquired an incapacity that renders us unable to do anything.
Guruvani
November 2004

This was not given by God for our desires. We must strive to embrace a dharma where we have been made instruments to execute the divine will. For this dharma, you, your children, or our contemporaries alone are not enough. We need the application of progeny endowed with the intellect to remove the errors that have occurred over aeons. We have also been shown how to do this. There is no need to waste time idly talking just because it has been revealed to us. Let us always remain vigilant. That vigilance must become a truth preserved for the sake of our lineage. So, what shall we do with this truth? How shall we receive it? How should it be transmitted to this land and country through us? Should we revert to the karma of calling upon God while divided by caste, religion, and race? Or should we realize that this is a reality ordained by God for all of us? Rather than wasting time overthinking how we can reach the karma that we analyze, we should proceed by applying only the knowledge we have been given.

What is it? If we are to move away from the karma that we usually refer to as that of yogis and karmis—or even the ones where astrologers satisfy us with offerings by telling the tales of deities—we have been granted a karma by God where we are immediately told what our ruin is, what caused our ignorance, and where we stand in this ignorance. However, because we do not realize that we are receiving such a great fortune, if we stand aside with our very petty minds and fight, where will we reach? We will not be able to achieve anything.

Therefore, it is not just about our life; we should not be absorbing the heat of the departed souls from wherever they exist. We are the ones who must think about the temperature of those souls. Nothing can be done about it. Thus, it is the mistake that has occurred in the light of numerous eras passed across Manvantaras, whether through the prophetic paths, the system of goddesses and gods, or the system of the Trinity, which came about within and outside these modes of worship. This is being revealed to us. This is our greatness. What is being revealed? We have arrived at a very magnificent karma that gave us the opportunity to be born in a time ordained by God for this revelation, and for our soul to separate from our body at that very time. This is not just for us, but it should completely become an understanding for all kinds of people and even all living beings, and the merit acquired from this understanding should be passed on to our children; we must instill in our children the determination to stand firmly in the good deeds we do today. Through them, we should give that love to the world. That should be the goal of our life.

So, regarding this goal, people might say that it is Vedanta being spoken, or that such things exist in the realm of knowledge. In this special karma, permitted to impart to us the aspect of knowledge from the divine presence, the experience each of us acquires should flow through our children, passing on to us, our ancestors, and the future generations; since we are in a karma that has been extremely delayed in adopting such an experience, we must not have any other resolve except the singular determination that we will perform our karma with God at the forefront, to the best of our understanding. That is all we have to do. By fulfilling that, we are clearing the path for the coming children to act, thereby eradicating the prolonged miseries of our souls. You must not drift away from this karma. Although this has been reiterated many times, it is understood that most people find it difficult to grasp. Therefore, it is impossible for you to grasp it if it is explained to you point by point. What is it? Let me say it in brief.

Through the permission granted by God, we are able to see the karmic flaws that occurred across these Manvantaras, and we must observe the miseries of the great souls who acted as the greatest scholars and the most perfected sages there. For one, it is enough to look at our recent times. Going further back would be very difficult for us. Finally, before the beginning of this Kali Yuga, it was Sri Krishna who was born for us and demonstrated it for the welfare of this world. However, since we are nothing in that realm of knowledge, the scholars later rewrote it as well. We are witnessing the play of the narrative hidden behind the miracle, told as a story that created wonders through incarnation and birth once again. This is not what we need.
Guruvani
December 2004

We must observe the suffering starting from Sri Krishna. In the karma that is yet to come, God has given us a karma where we reduce it to ashes and, in a way, preserve it as *Vibhuti* (sacred ash) and prosperity. We are capable of undertaking this. We must undertake it. I have said this for you numerous times, or perhaps I said it for myself numerous times. But you are unable to take it up with that level of determination. Nor am I able to make you do it. If both these kinds of pain reach God, it is the greatest injustice we inflict upon ourselves. That is why I am telling you, and why these ancestors, yogis, and karmis have been kept aside. Giving them a chance to be born in their zodiac will not happen through anything other than our good deeds. At a time when we possess such an inheritance, along the path imparted with the determination, detachment, and love that we must become fully capable of accomplishing it, we must all work in unison and place our karma before the world; even if not everyone can understand the course of this life, we must develop faith in the merit that our Guru lineage will purify and humble all of us, and we must translate that faith into action. So, when it is said that the faith should be translated into action, it refers to the past faith. Not the one existing today. In that karma given by God as an opportunity to observe and articulate the greatest complete error or truth of the past faith and the one existing today—all of us—it is called Gurupooja here. If asked what this Gurupooja is, we do not have the time to explain it. During that Gurupooja, God reveals it to us. What is it? How your ancestors are. Where their souls stand, under which deity they are, what has happened in the karma of which gods and goddesses. To change this, if we just call out "Oh God," it becomes clear. Once it becomes clear, it dissolves into the light shown by God. That is neither our greatness nor the greatness of the world. All this is a profound knowledge we received according to that cosmic will. Having reached the realm of this knowledge, we must not run mindlessly behind the greedy people who turn into wealthy and clever individuals in the future generations, performing karma for wealth accumulation and showing deceit through commerce, thereby imparting the greatest baseness. Let us have the wisdom to live with what we have received, and let us not go into a karma that imparts an emotional form into the future children by showing them the greatest illusions. This requires some effort. Because we do not have the ability to take up and act upon this encyclopedia of knowledge that has been passed down through the epochs. Then what is it? Preserve the word received from God in that manner and walk according to this word. That is how we were told with the greatest evidence by an *Avadhuta* that "Word is Truth, Truth is Guru, Guru is God". I had doubts back then. What is it? It is neither what I did nor any mistake committed by our people. So, the karma proven by that *Avadhuta* is that the disability we have suffered to this day is due to not safeguarding this word. It was also the truth. It remains the truth to this day. And it will always be the truth. All of you must be able to act from that conviction. For that, each of us is growing into the dharma of imparting the determination to attain it, not only in the lineage we steadfastly see, hear, and know, but in each of the children we love. Pray to God for that.
Guruvani

The evolutionary secret of life shared with the world in the karmic state through the disciple

You should have an understanding. What is meant by that understanding--in a way, you know a fair bit. There are Yugadharmas (duties of the age) obtained through the system of the Trinity. Humanity has been worshiping the concepts of gods and goddesses that have come within all those Yugadharmas, and also in the sense of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva related to it--as Shaktheyam, Shaivam, and Vaishnavam. So, in all those aspects of worship--we stop by giving a concept of our ownٹ Anyway, it is by conceptualizing a divine glory that we conceptualize from a demon to a god or to a sage. Thus, there are various states in this path of the concept of the sage. We do not know about it. After the status of the Trinity, there is the realm of the sages. We are seeing this realm of the sages with our own eyes. Apart from a few great souls who have come so far, there are people who cannot understand what it is and act accordingly. When looking at our knowledge, there is Sree Rama, and after that Rama Tirtha, Sree Sankara, Rishi Sai, and similarly Nabiٹ then some people. These people who came isolated stood somewhat attached to certain lineages. But for all these, there is no such thing as a Guru lineage. That is, it is called the path of instruction. This path of instruction is not present in all Gurus. Another one is the prophetic path. It is said about Nabi among those who came in recent times at the highest level. But even he, in his final days, told you the nature of that prayer. So, to this day, no one has understood what exactly this thing is that has happened to many people like this. If you think about it, as a result of being in a karma that goes very downward, the country itself was lost. Today, what is called their country is said to have been lying together with India. So that karma that was born there -- it had come together back then. As a result of how it was chopped and cut, bringing changes to the place, today it stands separate. All the Gurus up to today who were in India after that have not known any of this. But did the prophetic religion know? Not that either. They were not able to see this. That is not due to fault. The reason for not being able to see is the mistake that has happened to us so far. The mistake that happened to us is a system prepared by those ancestors to establish us secondly by removing us from the lineage of this Manu. So, how and through what did that karma called Manu come? That is unknown. That Manu was depicted as the son of Brahma by historians who came later or by Gurus who were ancestors, and we became unable to achieve it from this later. This is true for the Gurus who have come to this day. We can see from their own words that it is true for the prophets as well. But this has been touched upon here and there when speaking about certain Puranas in another way. How? There is a saying by a demon that I will not let the one who comes to see you go there, near you. Some among ourselves say that we suffer because we stand between the devil and God. Such sayings are often heard. Thus, overcoming the states of these gods and goddesses and seeing what the sage system is, these Puranas waited for numerous opportunities to tell who has come forward in that path of karma which has come as the power of that Supreme—whether it is under the god, above the god, or as Parashakti, in that sage system. They have tried to bring out the complete scholarship of each person to say it. But none of them have been able to say any of this. In this, a saying occurred through Sree Krishna and through Aurobindo or through thinkers in Western countries who stood with faith in God. But they could not grasp this. The reason for that is that each of the great souls who went truthfully in thought came and did not worship under anything. Sree Krishna came as a proof of that very thing. Sree Krishna did not worship anyone. Similarly, it is not seen that this Subramanya did much penance. But he just quickly passed through all the states. After this, since Subramanya really liked Kerala, he spoke to his Guru about wanting to go to Kerala. But the Guru saw it. If let go like this, this will come only through another matter. Therefore, he did not let him go. Without letting him go--a great man named Bhogar was his Guru--he made an idol with Navapashana (nine poisons), smeared the likeness of Subramanya on it, consecrated it, and gave it a concept. And his Samadhi is in the cave seen beneath it. You can go and see it even today. This idol stands facing southwest. Although many things are seen to be roughly said, it has not been received as a true statement. Not many people have been able to just see it in a true life. The people in Western countries have said that this is not the story of God. In their thoughtٹ it ٹ they have come as the souls of sages. So, not only did the rulers of that time not agree with any of this, but they also punished and killed all of them. That was how the government was back then. However, even though many people came as Gurus in India after that, they could not bring this. The reason for this is that whoever we may be--this has been said before--just take a look at that history, according to our knowledge, we cannot look back beyond ten, a thousand, two thousand, or three thousand years. But even to look at this, one must cross over the state of a god. Otherwise, no one can even look at this. Where does this god stand, where does the sage stand, where does the ascetic stand, where does the liberated one stand, where does the enlightened one stand—very few have known about such a course of karma. So, it will take numerous eras for this course of karma to be passed down. But you may ask, wouldn't God know all this? He knows. Initially, God brought man himself to this knowledge. That is what is called Manu. Even after six Manvantaras of that Manu, in the state of the Chaturyugas (four epochs) that came later, a great man looked back there. What is it? How has my lineage come? When he looked at what he was then, he saw his action. So, it is in the sense of what is called this Brahman that they praise saying the Guru is Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva. In whatever deity of worship we give a concept to, whatever state it has, Brahma will be seen there in that state. Then we will also see its nature. Everyone will just praise and extol what they have seen. We did not have a situation to cross over beyond this and act by observing and knowing. Therefore, as soon as such a mistake occurred, it is said that three Chaturyugas lay inactive. What functioned later is this Trinity lineage. It functioned as ten Chaturyugas. Functioning through these ten Chaturyugas and reaching this status of Devendra, the form or the step said merely as a play, when passing six and reaching there, if it is said that Shiva was seen, it means that if you reach that sixth step, then that form will not be seen. It stands merged into another. When looking at what that standing entity is, it is the nature of Brahman (Brahmamayam). Brahmamayam is present everywhere, isn't it? We have suffered a misfortune of not being able to look back through generations with enough intellect or historical knowledge to see why it has come. Then why did we get it like this? Here and now, someone among the people who have seen this must say it. As far as I am concerned, I did not set out searching for any of this. I did not even know this. Falling into a mistake, some people say that Kundalini will awaken by falling into a mistake. Thus, by mistake, I jumped into a pit. But it was only by that divine resolve (Brahmanischayam) that I was somehow able to come out of that pit. Otherwise, there is no greatness of mine in it. All these great men mentioned are not small men. They belong to the lineage of numerous Gurus who functioned throughout the ages. Thus, how many Buddhas, how many Brahmas—such things are there in the Puranas. If it is the time of a Brahma, why say like this about that matter? But we do not know this. So, because we came upon an ignorance like this, scholars or those curious about it or Acharyas have waited to get an opportunity to come forward. But this has happened by God's command. The Guru lineage, that is, the Manvantara. But this Manu got linked as the son of Brahma. So, misunderstanding that to be the Manu lineage, they saw all this keeping it under this Brahma. As a result of that observation, no one got the opportunity to know about this. This has happened to numerous great men. Similarly, regarding myself, I am seen as having been born for numerous ages. Why is it that having been born like that, it was not completed later? When these mentioned things are done and completed--that is, the matter destined for each one--they will not go right beyond that. It is said that they will just do up to what is destined and go. This is the evidence that has come. Like that, after repeating many times without mistake, if there are any children here, they have been able to see it. You should ask and know that. Even after seeing all this, they have not been able to complete it. Their parents are children who died without being able to achieve even a quarter of it, desiring completely for a modern fulfillment, when seen on the side of our ancestors. What will we get from that? We will not get anything. Then, saying like this is father, is mother, that is God, is Guru, father and mother are the primordial Gurus, but what have this mother and father done? They will finish their time as father, mother, children, husband, wife, and just die. They have not seen anything beyond this. And then, in the state of having ruled with strong governance, some children will show greatness saying father is father. Can this father who became a father say anything other than what he knows? But for them, the father is great. So, for the children too, it is the father who comes. So, the lineage of Manu is that there must be a father clear like the sky. Only that father can show about the lineage of this Manu. There has been no father or mother in that way. Otherwise, the matter of the Gurus who came was mentioned earlier. They too could not do it. The reason for that is that three Chaturyugas lay idle. When action came after that, various kinds of floods occurred over numerous ages. These times were ruled and caused to be ruled in various ways, and all the places that were submerged due to sin ended up in water. We know that recently too some islands were washed away. It is miles away. Apart from that, in Karnila, there are many thousands of people. They just went here and there. No one knows where they are. But there are some shortcomings in this that have come and gone over many periods like this. Only the Kali (age) can be a time capable of being taken together to change those disorders like this on this earth. None of this can be done in the Satya Yuga. What is Satya Yuga? It just comes and goes as truth itself. The three periods of this Chaturyuga are what repeats from one after that. It is that Guru coming in Dvapara, or coming from Treta Yuga, who has to come correcting it. Sree Rama is one of them. That too was done by performing the Putrakameshti ritual in the fire through many histories. The Puranas have written it down as the karma of Vasistha. It is also history that Sree Rama and Lakshmana went to guard that Yaga of Vasistha. Even though that Yaga of Vasistha was conducted then, that Yaga did not go outside of that karma which was divinely ordained. Thus, this remained unknown. When we saw Sree Rama like that and worshipped him and made others worship him, when this was studied and taught about Sree Rama, the story of these Avatara purushas (incarnations) came again. What is this incarnation? It has become confused in such a way that it is unknown how this has come before. It is because it came like this that Sree Rama went to the forest. That is the story fabricated and kept as the lies and greed of these women. Apart from finding a story to blame women, no one knew to say what it truly was. They have written that since Bharata ruled after that, the name Bharatam came. But how did he rule? It was by placing Sree Rama's feet. What is this matter of the feet that is said? It is true that this light or this knowledge should be at the Guru's feet. So what did they understand? These writers too could only understand that they worshipped by placing the elder brother's feet. Thus, by respecting the elder brother and giving a lot, and by making a situation where it seemed karma was done respecting the elder brother and sister-in-law, they wrote the story and praised it; because of that, what came from then on was brought to that karma called Ramo-Ramahcha-Kalki-Janardana, and when everything was ordained as incarnations, it is seen that more than twenty-five people came as these Gurus and did this. But this is seen in other religions as well. Going and standing there, how can this be seen? It cannot be seen. Because this was not possible, it had to return like this many times. But regarding me, coming like this for many days, I am just doing all that I am saying and stopping. I didn't do anything else. That is the matter that has been told and obtained here. Thus, it is said that giving a responsibility at that time, (I) was sent. It is said that it came and did it to explain and write what this medical science is. Therefore, even if there was an interest about that medical science, I did not desire to study anything even then. Now, because I had an inclination towards this, that is an experience with youٹ A small advertisement about Ayurveda came favorably with the permission of the Government of India. That is a small advertisement. Seeing it in the paper, it was immediately cut and kept. It remained in a book for a long time. Giving this and telling many people here about it, they have no understanding of it. Then, inquiring about this in the Secretariat, they said it was not there. The safekeeping in the Secretariat is like that. That file is simply not there. After this, it was sent straight to Delhi. What is it? Wasting money like this, how about going and checking there for the item without a file, which they say is not in the Secretariat? Otherwise, it certainly would not come in the paper. If it came in the paper, it would be a matter they had investigated somewhere. There would be an office for it. I sent someone saying this. The person sent stayed there for one, one and a half weeks. No such place was found. I have been walking like this for many days. Someone said such an advertisement had come. It is unknown what it is. Inquiring like that, again on the thirteenth day, its office was found in a corner. Went and inquired. Such a thing had happened. That permission was created when Raj Narain was sitting as the Health Minister. He is the one who allowed it. That is only in two states.

There is a subject that each of us, down to every child, desires. We have not taken up any practice that has been entirely prevalent until today, or even a part of it. We are proceeding without touching anything, yet touching everything and purifying its nature. What it is like is that not only all the gods and goddesses of our past forms of worship, but also the light that follows the five elements, after knowing what it is and how it connects with life and soul, some individuals among us, both men and women, know today what it is in action. You should not assume that this is because of the greatness of any of us or due to some service we have rendered. Some people who did not come here also saw this and came to ask me. At first, it felt difficult to give them an answer. The reason is, to see such a great thing, I have pondered about the evolutionary state of their souls and how they perceive it. But there is some reason for it. Even though many things have been explained, we haven't had the capacity to go through that much. That is a shortcoming that has come down through some eras of our own. We do not have the karmic tradition to change this. Also, it is not correct to say that anyone can attain it through any kind of wealth. Nor can it be believed that it will truly reside through some sacrificial ritual. Because the karmic principles that existed during the time of Kamsa can still be remembered by us today. Since then, many great souls have come. It has not been seen completely fulfilled in any of them. Then how will we complete this? It is indeed a doubt. However, those who were here initially were able to see some of this prescribed order. There were not many people. Not more than forty or fifty people would have seen it. Every day, knowing it like that for about six months and the subsequent karmic capacity of the experience to date—none of you have the authority to think about how we became worthy of it. Because there are great souls who have suffered the utmost hardships by making such great sacrifices. That includes Dayananda Saraswati, Buddha, and the numerous great souls who came after Krishna, who came before. We could not get it in a usable form from any of them to put into practice. Each great soul has spoken highly of it. We did not understand how to grasp it. Then it was justified in various guises and in this concept of Maya, as Mahamaya, or as the Lord's divine principle. The karma that has come through us, through our ancestors, is like this. But none of this will quench our thirst. If it is to be quenched, we must get a karma suitable for it. Many of you know how we get it. It is not rationalism, liberationism, or a path of dharma forged in the storehouse of intellect. We are seeing with our eyes, or the eyes of our inner vision, a traditional truth of the path of karma that stands beyond intellect. Even after seeing it, we do not understand what all has been done. How thousands of sages accept this is seen in the vision by both children and adults. Seeing this alone is not enough. What the Guru was there, how the Guru stands—that is the real subject we need to know. We only know some words that have come before us. We have heard an introduction saying that Guru is Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, and the Supreme Brahman. But we have not been able to realize any of that in experience. But we are bound to get this by ourselves when we behave in the truth that is the Guru. Rather than mere utterances and boasts aligning with the contexts of epics and puranas. This is entirely a karmic path seen in the lake of their minds. How much that karma grew and was nurtured is seen in the aspect of vision. Otherwise, the ignorance of claiming to have seen a vision of a god or goddess, or Mahamaya, or like the opening of Krishna's mouth that showed all the worlds, will not be correct in this. Saying that when Krishna opened his mouth, all the fourteen worlds and their stories were seen is just a fabrication, nothing else can be said about it. That is not the truth of it. As soon as Krishna was born, he said, do not keep me here, I should be taken to such and such a place. That is the truth. So, some ignorance came upon us, either because great souls could not explain and make us understand such karma, or because we could not be convinced of it. None of us can do anything about a karmic path that deliberately denies it. After they saw this, what was the Guru then? If the Guru had been there then, what all would he have done—this is its description. Knowing what the progress of the soul is, which is an imaginative aspect of such a Guru, is what happens with the arrival of the disciple. You who have been able to at least partially hear, know, and experience such a Guru-disciple relationship are indeed fortunate. Not just you, — I often give you an example for this. Just look at your children. At the age of those children, you, who are their father and mother, did not have that much intellect. How did this happen? This is heard in a karmic state explained from the night the Guruvayur temple caught fire. So, we must dedicate our lives to doing karma by becoming completely subservient to that honesty —or to that true reality—which you were able to be born into and give birth to in this time. This is the subject of this. What do we get from the evolutionary activity of this soul in the proximity of a Guru once you all understand this? This is its secret. This secret should be shared with the world in the karmic state through the disciple. There is no distinction of man or woman in that. There is no need to tell anything else to you who have been fortunate to become heirs to such a karma. Most people here know that this much is true. But they just do not know how it is. There are at least five hundred people among you today who have spoken at least two or four words about this. Furthermore, there are instances that clearly show us what the evolution of the soul completely is. Therefore, we do not need to convince them by talking more about it. The transmission of the karma that we perform entirely with a sense of dedication will reclaim this atmosphere. It stands in the dharma of mind, word, and action. If you just justify it in some way, it will not be correct. You will realize that there is a wave that is beyond thought, fully imparted in these three states. It is impossible to explain what it is like. It is beyond thought, beyond intellect too. A karma that has reached such a state is a gift bestowed by God upon you and your lineage. No matter how much each of you grieves over it, it will not increase. This is not a subject introduced for individual worship or for any religious doctrine. Each of you who has received the fortune to acknowledge, see, speak, act upon, and donate to the world what those dharmic actions of the great souls who have come until today are, is great. For this, you should desire and pray that God makes you eternally good. There is no other side to this. Therefore, once you reject the time destined for you by God, you must not resort to actions or karma ready to make someone else reject it. It is a great karmic principle that does the smallest possible karma and cultivates and highlights a great merit. Do not lose the opportunity God has given you so that none of you ever act forgetting this.
Guruvani
