You should know it as a karma itself. You can consider it as the first ceremony for that. It existed before. But it was a ceremony under the Deva. What you have understood it as is something else. You have seen it as Swayamvara. What is called Swayamvara, many of you have an understanding that it is choosing someone you like. That is not Swayamvara. There is a set of people called these Rajarshis. During the time they lived as the sage categories of the royal lineage, they used to give advice. Once the advice is given, whatever they have to do next, they will do only after mutually knowing it. Not only doing that, but to this they must handle it in any way only exactly as these people say. People have understood this as Swayamvara. It is not like that. Whenever we have whatever karmas or matters, all of that happens just as they say. The peculiarity of this back then is that for all of them, they are accepting the things said by this Guru. What the Guru says means that in advance, in this manner, it is this, and only that should be obeyed. It is said that this child would have seen it beforehand in the way this Guru advises. Based on their chosen deity's logic, by the blessing of the Deva and Devi, they should see it in such a way. That is Swayamvara. Otherwise, it is not just doing as one pleases. But only this Guru knows that. The Guru takes this garland and gives it, saying so. We do not know this. We have assumed something else about it. That is wrong. However, there is another side to this path of ours. What is that? That was the time of the Deva. It was the Deva who was handling it. Today is not the time of the Deva. Apart from that, since the time of Sree Krishna until today, it has never existed. That is why most people could not know it. Ours is not like that. This is a girl, therefore we have also suffered a lot of ruin. And false depiction since the birth of Sree Krishna. What all things are taught today! It is in the nature of stale writers. What is said is not true. We do not even know this. A greater great soul than Sree Krishna has not been born. By birth, no one has come like that as a person who came as a Jnani. However, there are also those who through birth come doing great karma again. Since most of us do not know this, there is no point in explaining about it. A girl or a boy of ours should bring a change to this. To bring that change, this is a matter that was told and received here in seventy-three. But it could never be implemented until now. Someone took it up, and did it without knowing. Following that, as it was being discussed, some have started doing this. What this is like is that while we are alive, do not assume that everyone will get whatever is there in the past worship system. The announcement in this is that most people will get it. How that is, is that what our ancestors worshipped, right now most people here are getting it, they are seeing those worshipped items. They are also seeing the Guru. Seeing whatever happened back then, they are seeing the Guru again. The belief is that upon seeing this, their karma is untied. Many among those sitting in this group of ours, both men and women, have that. Today itself there is a person here who says that even now it is not possible. Not everyone can bear it like that. Only those whose soul has fortune can bear it. For those who don't, being unable to bear it, such anxiety will occur. Various kinds of ignorance will come. But it is said that all this should be done only after telling the Guru. This person had an excessive desire. What it is like is that many here have (the experience). I told him it is difficult. But after two or three years, this person could not bear it. One day he came and said, whatever it is, I want that. I said, if you can do it, do it. Then you can ask him the rest of the matter, I don't know. Thus, do not think that everyone can ask and get this. You won't get it. Some people have such a fortune. Even if given because they have fortune, they won't be able to carry it. There is such a flaw. What is it? The knowledge in their soul is only that much. Even if they are some small children, they bear it. But they do not get that much anxiety about it. Because I say this, do not assume that grown-ups won't get it. Right now, among those sitting here itself, there are more than fifty people, men and women, who are getting it. What we need to understand is that, once the time of the Deva is over, what we get through that Deva is less. We have assumed that if we get it, a Deva or a Devi or a glance is enough. That is not correct. Thousands of Devas and Pitrus, crores of entities starting from Pishachas to Yakshis, Kinnaras and Gandharvas—people who have sight of them are still inside this. But I am not saying that any of this is good. We should be able to see without knowing that such a truth exists. But you do not need to see any of this as a big deal. Nor should you give this a big position. Moreover, carrying this knowledge without a Guru is also not right. This should be carried only if there is a Guru. Otherwise this is a karma with many complications. Because among our ancestors there might be sorcerers. There might be many evil-natured souls that lived in very vile occupations. Similarly, there are demons polluting this whole atmosphere and a dirty type of spirits called jinns—all these will deceive us. Therefore, if we do not know such things very carefully, it is dangerous. Because of this, for many people in this one ten or sixty years, there are many places where they say there is a vision there, a vision here—that they are jumping, dancing, or seeing apparitions. But none of this needs to be correct. Why is that? We do not need to see this Deva and Devi as a big deal in that matter where we had assumed that this Deva and Devi were something great. We shouldn't see it as big regarding this either. Nor should we see it as small. It is none of that. This is a new ceremony concerning us, a new ceremony for this human world. What this is like is that we have only heard that it is attainment over many lifetimes. It is said that it is a truth that comes to benefit our soul after that attainment of many lifetimes. It is not like that. This dharma of this Kali is the best concerning us, it has been said many times. Sree Krishna has said a phrase, Kali is in the Shudra. But we did not even understand what Sree Krishna has said. When saying Kali, Shudra, we have assumed something here. That what is called Shudra is a caste. It is not a caste, it is a varna. When saying varna, it means one in the fourth quarter, one who has no authority over the Vedas in other times. That is what is called an ignorant person. So whoever is there in this Shudra class. It is there in the Brahmin's house, it is like that in the Kshatriya's house too. It is there in the Vaishya's and Shudra's house. But this is not what we have assumed. When saying Shudra, it is as a caste. It is not that. It is speaking about the lineage where Sree Krishna was born. The reason for Sree Krishna's birth must be a birth that comes at the beginning of Kali. That must be a perfect Guru. Otherwise, a flaw will happen to it. That is because one must not worship the entity that was being worshipped until then. You know Sree Krishna clearly. Have you seen Sree Krishna worshipping anyone like that? Or have you heard it said? You all know how we got this Sree Krishna again to worship. But the matter is not that. The men and women that were obtained through the attainment of many eras—that is what you call sixteen thousand and eight. It means took birth eight times. Those eight times of birth are the same woman he married. Eight births. All the rest were acquired by worshipping from a divine standpoint. We also call them Gopa women. In this system of worship, now is the time when we will get Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya and Shudra. But to get this, it is only possible according to the fortune and the age of our soul. Even if obtained, because it is obtained a little bit and stops, for some it is impossible to take it otherwise. That is why I just showed someone. Will get it. Unable to take it. He himself will tell you that matter. Why is he being made to say this, often? Do not assume that this is a game. It is not a game. We will completely get a period where we can take God's love. That is a help of the Guru. If that help is obtained like that, we see entirely how many births we have taken, been born and died. After that, whatever one needs to become, one becomes that oneself. Whatever needs to enter one's soul, it comes. This is the peculiarity here. There are those who discarded it despite everyone getting it, there are those who cannot take it, there are those who discarded it thinking it is nothing. There are many such types here itself. This is a karma with great hardship and pain. The author of the Gita himself tells us that it is a karma earned over eons. But if it is like that, one can ask why we are getting it like this. There is proof that we will get it—people of all castes and religions among our people are getting it. This is our proof. The ignorance that God placed in caste and was worshipped here, or the ignorance that was worshipped, in many such ways we have earned a type of useless ignorance. We have assumed that all this is God's play. It is never a knowledge of God. It is strictly the special intellect of that time which tells us that the time of Kali is indeed good. This is coming into us itself. When this comes like this, a karma is coming for the children born since this seventy-three and their traditional ancestors to be born with a right to liberation. For that, this child—boy or girl— this boy should stand as a Brahmachari. When saying this Brahmachari, you might think it is carrying around some pretense. No. By birth we are born as a boy or a girl. This girl and boy should have a self-knowledge. We should not become bad. We must— this child must strictly be like a Brahmacharini. This boy must also be like a Brahmachari. So what is called Brahmacharya—you say various things that kings practiced. What is it? In the olden times, going to the gurus, staying there and learning throughout the education period, to know how ruling is, how one should rule, how one can serve the people. That is why the king is seen as a visible God. So this king ruled like that. That king is not seen like that at all after Kamsa. This was first told to Kamsa. You should not do this. If you do this, I will bring someone to your own house for the karma of killing you and destroying you. He has knowledge of that. That if he does not act straight, he will be destroyed. Therefore he beat to death everything that was born. But he didn't get one in his hand. You know what happened because of that. Besides finding pleasure in telling stories, having investigated anything about this, what did you do for the benefit of this Shudra class? Or which era's truth of people's knowledge do we need? It is not to say that nothing of the past happened. If said it doesn't exist, that won't do either. But for us, the time we got to be born is fortunate. With the lives of such people, everyone born now is born as children of the upcoming age. That is not in one caste or religion. Everyone, when saying this Satya Yuga, it means an age without forgetfulness. Man has no forgetfulness at all. Wherever he sits, he knows what all is happening and how. This is the mark of Satya Yuga. But now we cannot comprehend like that. The reason is that for these three yugas, or whichever time the mistake happened in this aspect of vision, for those times we are unable to know this matter. It is exactly like that in every religion. It is like that in every caste and order. Transforming this is the biggest subject of this. This is one of the biggest karmas of our human world. We can fully achieve that only if we are fortunate. Otherwise, it will be passed down from our Guru lineage. They will be the ones teaching how to rule the world. This is a truth of this. So we should also have a determination that these seven generations should go on without making a mistake. It is said that if we make a mistake in this, then in this yuga a human birth will not be obtained. The coming generation cannot be born immediately. They will have to go and be born at the beginning of the Treta Yuga. The fourth quarter of the Chaturyuga is what is happening now. That is Kali. Whoever taught us saying that Kali is no good, that is an ignorance that came about in a tantric vidya. This ignorance is an ignorance that befell all people. It befell all religions. It befell whatever doctrines have come until today. But getting rid of this is a complete reason for our ceremony today. But how you should see this being removed is, within yourselves there are men and women, young and old. You can see. But you are each showing a plight where you cannot take this up. This is a proof that is there after he (pointing to someone) did Guru Pooja. A ceremony called Guru Pooja is being done here. But his focus shifted. How many like this are here. This is being told for you to understand. After he also did Guru Pooja, when he went about messing it up, I summoned him here. He knows that himself. Let you understand this. Besides that, do not assume that we are making something up and doing it. God has donated a karma destined for us, for our sake. This should not be lost. When we grow up, our father's and mother's ancestral doers, and similarly the acharyas who have come in the world till today, each of us working to end their sorrows—I told you before what that is. The knowledge was received before Sree Krishna was born.

Did you inquire and find out about all of that? Most of our people are those who, having witnessed all this, attempt to perceive it through the magnitude of mystical feats. When viewed through the lens of these mystical feats, such powers are attributed to a deity, a sorcerer of ancient times, or an evil spirit. You should not presume that it belongs to a human being or a similarly deserving soul. You have considered this a great matter, labeling it as the domain of a Yogi, a ritualist, or a devotee, and have kept it as something distant and unattainable. No, this is Yoga. Yoga means fortune. It is not merely the act of expanding the lungs by inhaling through the nose and mouth. Believing that to be Yoga, numerous theories have been written down claiming that it cuts through the phlegm congestion of the nerves. None of these constitute the fortune of the soul. Now, if some children happen to receive good fortune, you would say it is their great fortune. You have perceived that solely in terms of wealth. It is indeed a fortune in terms of wealth. That is certainly one type of fortune. But this is not that. It encompasses all types of fortune. It is the act of removing whatever entities were worshipped by all kinds of souls of our past. Regarding this, they themselves will narrate a truth that has occurred among this gathering. Initially, I did this through certain astrologers. Because there was no other alternative. I did not know how to explain and make them understand. How could I explain it? Therefore, it was done using astrologers. However, our people simply did not understand it. They thought it depended on the calculations of the astrologer. Today, there is proof of that here. Let them narrate it to you themselves. If there is anyone who knows how to narrate it, please speak. I have said this because if you do not see, hear, and understand this, you will be deceived.

Experiencer: It has only been two years since I became a believer in the Guru. Five to eight years prior to that, I owned thirty cents of land in Cherthala. There was no place I had not visited in order to sell that property. From everywhere I went, I would be sent back with a promised date. When visiting temples, they would say it would happen after forty-one days. Thus, I visited numerous temples. Thereafter, when I came to have the *darshan* of the Guru for the first time, I told the Guru right away that I had a thirty-cent plot in Cherthala, and that despite going to many places, I had not been able to sell it. The very first thing the Guru told me was, "Dear one, you just pray." I went home and spent my time in prayer. My mother and I came here together. After arriving, I explained the situation to the Guru in detail. I mentioned that there was a serpent grove and thick vegetation there, and therefore, everyone who came to inspect the land turned back. No one would buy it upon seeing it. That was the condition of the land. Then the Guru said, "Let all that remain there. It can be removed when the time comes." After that, when I returned home, people started coming in large numbers for the land. At that time, it was a person from Vaikom itself who came and paid an advance to buy the property. The agreement was for a period of six months. Even after six months, there was no sign of them preparing to register the property. The reason was that they were a party who bought and resold real estate, and after they entered into an agreement for this land, even their other properties were not being sold. They came to me and said, "Brother, after taking this land, none of our other trades are moving." They had a suspicion; they did not know if it was because they took this land. You must certainly believe this: it was precisely because they took it that their other land was not selling. It was a land with such severe afflictions. It was due to the presence of these worshipped deities. They were worshipped deities such as Nagaraja and Nagayakshi. That was revealed in the astrological consultation. The Guru had already told me about it. The people who bought the land and I together went to an astrologer. The astrologer then stated that entities like Nagaraja, Nagayakshi, Arukola, and Yakshi were present there. The astrologer stated that it would only change if a major *homam* (fire ritual) was conducted. I told the person who came to buy the land, "I am a believer of this path. Therefore, I will do it only after asking the Guru." Knowing this, the astrologer said, "Then, you pray." I held onto my Guru and prayed. After that, he first said that the serpent had moved away. The astrologer was saying that what remained after that was even more powerful. I said, "You check it. How can you say without checking?" Then he laid out the cowries a second time. Upon checking, he saw a pattern where all of these were completely removed. Then how would they know it was changed? I said, "Let me go to my Guru and return; let me tell the Guru." I came here and told all these things to the Guru. Only my mother and I were present. The Guru called the *Janani* (Mother) and had it checked. Then, He explained the manner in which it had been removed, and instructed us to pray earnestly. After all that, when I went there, they immediately came running to me. It was to go to the astrologer again. The three of us went to the astrologer again. I had taken permission from the Guru. He had told me to go and check whenever I wished. On that day, Saturday was not an issue at all. There were many other people waiting to conduct astrological consultations that day. Thus, the astrologer checked. Upon checking, all these entities had been completely removed from there. It had been previously stated that the house had no divine grace. Now, upon checking, the very same astrologer said that complete divine grace was seen there. My Guru had completely removed all of that. They too believed it. I told them that it is a method of removal through mere divine resolve (*sankalpa*), without offering even a single flower. I possess that experience. All of them are now ready to come to the ashram. Subsequently, on that very day, immediately after the astrological consultation, they said that the *chitrakoodam* (serpent abode) should be removed from there. There were groves in two locations. I asked the Guru about that as well, asking what I should do. The Guru said, "You can boldly remove it." He added that if I wanted, I could call some believers from there to join me. The three of us who went initially went together. Internalizing the Guru's words, we went there, sprinkled some *theertha* (holy water), and prayed. After praying to the Guru earnestly, and with the Guru's permission, we removed it from there. Now, the very people who bought the land say that there is a special illumination there. Previously, they were hesitant to even come there. This is my experience.

Guru: You must understand what this means for us. This is what we previously worshipped. Whatever that encompasses can be removed. How to remove it? Not by throwing it away. But by granting it liberation; whatever fruits we would have obtained by living and worshipping it for so long, perform karma in such a way as to receive a thousand times that fruit, enabling its liberation, rebirth, and ultimate salvation. This is the divine will. Not many people know that this is such a divine decree. And I haven't done anything to make it known either. But despite having done this for over twenty-five thousand families, not even a handful of families are able to carry this forward truthfully. The same applies to the house of that boy I just called and made to stand. What can be done? He is also experienced. But if you do not revere this, you should not come here and handle it. It is dangerous. Because it is not I who does this. I am merely an instrument. Do this as something belonging to God. Do any of you think that all the various installation sites here will be removed, without even leaving this place? No one has gone anywhere from here for this. Only through pure resolve (sankalpam). That is 'Sankalpamatrena Parameshwara' (Parameshwara by mere resolve). The power up to Parameshwara can be shifted by mere resolve. The great Rishis did this in those times. This is a Rishi. You should not assume that a Rishi is someone who goes somewhere and hoards titles and honors. This is the time we have received. For us, many here have demonstrated a shortcoming in being unable to grasp it. Mostly, it is their doubt. Another reason is the lack of spiritual fortune of their soul. Those with such a lack of the soul's fortune cannot perfect it. However they try to hold onto it, that lack of the soul's fortune weakens them. There are such people here too. The person mentioned first lacks that spiritual fortune. Similarly, there are many here. There are more than thirty people sitting inside here right now. You do not know this. As long as you do not understand it this way, if you deal with this, you will not be able to know anything. When I mentioned 'seventy-three', until then, one would grieve and suffer, knowing what everything was within this Trimurti system. This is what happened until '73. Then one might ask, did no sorrow come after that? Yes. Countless sorrows. Among them, one sorrow came from Wayanad. They know this. When a word was spoken, they disobeyed and proceeded with the Gurupooja. When I went there, what happened? Don't you know the matter concerning Devarajan's sister and brother-in-law? That is what I asked to be told.

A disciple: Devarajan from Bathery came here with an illness that could not be cured by medicine. When he had the fortune to stay here and perform karma, there was some relief to his illness. Following that, his sister and her husband also started coming. There were differences of opinion between them at the time. The husband also had some mental issues. They were always fighting with each other. It was said that this was not resolving permanently or completely. Thus, when the Guru was traveling, Devan's sister was told not to come there. Yet she came. When arriving in Kozhikode, she was told not to travel further. But she boarded a bus and came to the ashram. At that time, this husband and daughter were there. Their house was near the ashram. They had come there. They did not have the culture, knowledge, or fortune to go along together. I also told the Guru, "Guru, he has come and is standing there. He is in deep distress." The Guru said, "Haven't we already said everything? What can we do?" The Guru repeatedly told her not to come there. She did not obey. It is not something to be pacified by calling it fate. Were not two lives lost due to disobedience? Following that, how much did so many journalists have to write about our institution and the Guru! Much headache and struggle ensued behind that. If told to do a thing in a particular way, they will absolutely pay no heed. They will mix it up in their minds and do something else. Then it becomes a total mess.

Guru: So, there are many incidents in this manner. What is being recounted to you is not a doctrine of gods, goddesses, and prophets. If we do not understand this properly and worthily, the danger that can befall us is not small. Why is the danger not small? Such people will not get a birth even in the next yuga. It is also said like this: the womb (yoni) will change. Through whatever species that give birth now, humans and all other birthing species, they will be born in altered forms and wander as dogs and cats, thus roaming through billions of births in that manner before returning. This is a truth. Our seers of vision state this. But this is not known. The people simply do not know. This became clear only in this lineage of Sri Krishna. But this is alien to you. The way you celebrate Sri Krishna is like this: sixteen thousand and eight. I do not know how such a wretched familiarity came into your midst. The saying that he married eight is not about marrying while living. It represents a state attained over eight births. That is why he is Yogeshwara Krishna. How much evidence you have! But the fact is that this ignorance of the Hindus never changes. That is the biggest thing that has happened to date. Then one might ask, do other religions not have this? They do. Because they came after the mistake of these Hindus. Whatever forms, wherever you see them today—those prophetic religions, paths of Gurus, paths of Yoga, and doctrines—you must understand that it is not just in this Kali Yuga, but how many Kali Yugas have passed by like this. This is the Kali Yuga of this one Chaturyuga.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Birthday Offering Edition 2004
Become the masters of the karma that strives for the soul.

The deity, or as we now call them, the rishi, the ascetic, the practitioner, the wise one, the devotee. This has its own unique capability. If we are to transcend that capability, we need someone to guide us. Simply guiding us minimally and instructing us to chant the Moola Mantra or the Jnana Mantra will not serve the purpose. This is not that. In the lineage of the Prophet, the Prophet is the one who pronounced the ultimate truth that there is nothing other than You. However, finally, three months prior to his passing, he engaged in a supplicatory prayer. That is history. Here, when they hear this Adhan, some people would spread at least a towel and perform Namaz there. They will hold their hands like this. We must understand what that is like this. That is, they are performing an action that he begged for on that day. They are asking, "O Father! We do not know what this is that is seen." Then they are praying from there. Supplicatory prayer. That is what they mean when they bow on their knees and perform the Namaz, saying it must be recited like this. They have proceeded in this manner. He is a prophet who came at the very end. Should we or should we not understand the fact that even though so many of these masters came to India, they did not understand this in any way? Once that is understood, if we debate who said the greater thing and who said the lesser thing, where will we end up? It is quite clear that we have such a flaw. (To change this) This is called the Trimurti system among Hindus. Shaivism, Shaktism, and Vaishnavism. One says the Vaishnava is greater. Another says the Shaiva is greater. Yet another says no, the Shakta is greater. To whom should we go to know what is lesser and what is greater? What is being said here is a practice that follows our path of mantras. No one can say that it does not exist. Who will we go and ask about who is greater and who is lesser in this? Is everyone great, or is one of them great, or are they all bad? Then they will just keep holding on to the branch they caught. Should we or should we not know that our predecessors have placed such a predicament before us? Upon seeing this knowledge, should we or should we not know how to discard it or how to adopt it? Only a person capable of discarding all three of these, namely the aforementioned Shaktism, Shaivism, and Vaishnavism, can do this. Only then can they guide you well. If this is what happened to Islam, which proclaimed that there is nothing other than You, then what is the meaning of the words of Jesus, who said instead let the rocks split, when he asked, "Father! Have you forsaken me?" Is this right or wrong? How are the followers of Narayana Guru Swami, who said that caste should not be asked, spoken of, or thought about, acting? "This too is our Swami!" Right? Thus, in each case, the rabbit they caught has horns. Proceeding in this state, things have become ruined across our generations. To change this, we must mutually understand what this apostle says, or what this saint says, or what this Sri Shankara says, or what even Narayana Guru has said today. Shouldn't we? Then we must act towards it. Otherwise, it will be detrimental to us. Otherwise, we will not seek anything in this. Everything we do will become a disaster for our future generations. Then we will not be able to do anything. What I am saying here is my own understanding. It is not simply stated in a commercial language. If you ask what caused me to say so—even if you ask, I will tell you. But I am telling you this because I have studied it that way. In that context where our mothers and sisters or our grandchildren are supposed to grow, if we hold on to all this and praise it as God, we must see where we will end up after death. Or does life end once we die? Then it will go and stay somewhere. Must we not check under what this existing soul is stationed, grasp it, set it on the right path, and grant liberation even to that under which it stayed? Isn't there an acquaintance shaped by so many of our ancestors worshipping? What is the use of holding it here without granting it liberation too; won't it cause harm from there? You should understand it this way. Other matters come later. Then, didn't you ask if you couldn't go to this temple? You can. You must go to the temple. But how? Some of you who come here are often heard saying something like this. The fact is that other than coming and going, they haven't understood this. That is, when you come like this, they come saying they have some illness, some trouble, or that their boy is not well-behaved, or their girl is not well-behaved. When they are asked and made to understand if they are convinced that there is a specific flaw in this, "Yes, everything is clear, now what should be done? It must be removed. How to remove it? Just remove it for us." And then? Then we will do what is necessary. How? By going to that Madan shrine—understood? This is what going to do what is necessary means. I said, you don't need to come here for that; I will change it for you. There is no karma for this. There is no justice. There is no justification. I will change it. You must do such and such. You, as parents and children, must be like this. Only then will my doing this bear fruit. Otherwise, you yourself will go and invite it back, do unnecessary things, and render this effort of mine vain. I am doing this for you by expending this karma of mine accumulated over eras. If you do it, do it after understanding that. They will fold their hands and say they will do it. But apart from these words, if anything happens, they will go and sit at the nearest family temple and the nearest some major temple. Then, is there any use because of what was done? This must be changed first. That does not mean tearing it all down and throwing it away. Let all that remain there. Demolishing stones and bricks will not make it go away. So, feeling that let it stay there for you, you should embrace an action capable of teaching our children what to do about it. Or will you tell them to get out when they grow up? I am not speaking of karma in this manner. It is to acquaint you with transforming this that I have come here. You have an obligation to ask why I happened to come here when I do. This is the reason for telling you not to go to the temple. If I change this for you and tell you not to do this, and that we must do such-and-such from now on, you should not handle it unless you have understood it. Otherwise, it will only bring us further harm. It is dangerous if one does not learn to do it properly. We do not know where our ancestors and our parents go and stand after death. Then what are the characteristics of this soul? What must be done with it? Where should it be stationed? What I am telling you is the path to grant it rebirth or liberation. Is it possible not to say this? You are the authorities meant to show what you are to your coming generations, once you have understood this. Should this benefit our home, our land, and our nation, or is it enough if it benefits only our home? We should not act for the sake of our caste or for other superficial affiliations. It is not enough that only you understand this. If everyone you call father, mother, children, husband, and wife are not together in this, there is a defect. Do you know why? Suppose it was done out of your preference. When you go home, your mother will ask what was said earlier. Then, will you fail there or not? You will fail. When everyone fails like that, it's over. Make them understand first. We must speak to them only after making them understand it initially. Thus, a practice that benefits our father and mother, and if necessary, our land, home, and nation, must come into your hands. Otherwise, it will not go away just by showing off this pretension. Now, don't you want to hear about the temple? Do you know why I said this? I am saying this so that youths like you will ask. Only if asked can I speak. Otherwise, if told, one will just say, "Ah, fine, not bad," and leave. It is not that. Rather, by instilling in you an action subject to some resolution, you are becoming the owners of the karma striving for your souls. We all need this. Let us do it that way. By offering another excuse, it won't leave our homes. Else, is it possible to bring a rationalist and have it removed? Let us bring those who have everything. And ask them to remove all this. They won't be able to either. What I am stating here is not such a matter. This is not a karma I performed now, but rather some merit from past lives across immemorial time. For twenty-nine years, I have properly heard Pushpanjali for this duty passed on to me through words. What is this Pushpanjali? It means this scolding. About five thousand people have surrounded and yelled at me. But due to my Guru's grace, they did not beat me to death. That itself is a thing. A pinch from everyone together would have been enough to finish me. I could realize this only due to the maturation over twenty-nine years. I observed that by holding on to the arguments of this aforementioned deity, or goddess, or some other religion, or our own religion. After identifying what it was, when I looked for the action above it, I found Dharma. I have emerged from a lineage of Gurus who showed me that Dharma. I have not brought this in the manner that random people talk about. When you understand this, and when these young children grow up under your care, if we must do anything to improve these children, shouldn't our homes, lands, and country become good similarly, after entirely comprehending these matters? This is what I said earlier; didn't they teach not to invoke these devils? Who? The Prophet. They didn't leave him alone. They chased him away by beating him. That group drove him up one mountain and set fire to the other. But he survived by roasting and eating a dead animal and returned from there. Today our people go there, drag along these blocks of ice, travel to places where water is scarce, do all that tied work in that desert, and come back here showing off. They do not impart this understanding even to this home where they live with their children, husbands, and wives. "I have suffered this much, my daughter! Else, you should do only such and such. Children should do only such and such. I have suffered this much. I achieved all this by passing under this iron rod." They will impart nothing of this agony. This is a matter wrapped up merely to project the greatness of the father and the mother. Will we get anything good from their hands? Understanding it like this, what you need to know is what you should do so that something positive happens through you. Otherwise, what can we do if we quarrel over God or say, "My God is greater, take yours and throw it in the gutter!" But it is not that. If there is such a thing as God, it cannot be different things for different people. God will not become many, though interpretations might range higher or lower according to our understanding of God. Should we or should we not learn what such a divine contemplation should be and how it should exist? Learn this first. The rest can be learned later. Didn't I mention, did you observe that reality which rested upon the sufferings of the Prophet and Jesus? Similarly, it is said that the great saint known as our Sri Shankara leaped into a gorge. It is also said that Sri Rama went down into the water and attained Jalasamadhi. If asked why, there is no answer for that. The question is whether all this is needed among you youngsters or not. Learn like this. Then study how we should bring about whatever feels preferable to you, how... how it must be imparted to our wives, children, mothers, etc. First. Other things later. Do not discipline anyone to make them better. They will not improve like that anyway. If we do it this way, we will have to internally honor and understand what the karmic fate of our life is. That Dharma will pass to our children, our wives, and our mothers. It will reach wherever it can. Wherever the son arrives. It will reach them there too. Don't we need this one achievement? This is the matter.

There are certain determinations of subjects recognized in ashrams or even in the very nature of temples. We are utilizing them based on our misunderstandings. What is that? Showing miracles. From that, utilizing great occult powers (Siddhis) to convince people that 'this is God's will'—such things have existed before and still exist among us today. But is all this God? Does God need this? We have never thought about this till today. Then, in another way, yoga, sleight of hand, and magical powers have transformed to make us believe that this spiritual nature is such a great thing. Among us today, if most people see a sanyasi (renunciate) or someone with any other kind of imitative nature, what pierces their minds are the miraculous tricks of these magical powers. If we rejoice in these tricks, what divine quality do we get? Is our God such a God? If so, isn't it enough just to practice and observe all that? But that is not what we need today. We have thousands of habits that we have worshipped for a long time, whether right or wrong. To say they don't exist might be right for that moment. But they won't simply cease to exist. If we feel this needs to be changed, how can it be changed? Who should change it, and what kind of person should they be? Because we lack information about all this, we have misunderstood many things. It's not like that; not only can all this be changed, but you must also live according to the dharma of this era (Yugadharma). This is the greatest fortune we have received today. It is a mere illusion to desire that we can get this fortune realized through brahmacharis (celibates) or sanyasis. Why? Sanyasis don't have children or anything. And not many can live their way. Then what to do? The householders (grihasthashramis) who live by doing karmas should see what the center of worship of our ancestors was, who acted in many guises and languages, and without simply changing it blindly, they should do what is necessary for it and then bring about the change. Simply changing it without purpose won't work. We can only achieve it if we have such karmic capacity. When we do this, we face a lot of difficulties and hardships. I can only speak about the information concerning me. Whatever else has happened elsewhere, must have happened. And it will be conducted. Regarding me, since my childhood, I had a thought: what is it that we need to attain, and how will we accept it? Whatever it is, there was divine grace for that. As a guide to that, if the people who get it and handle it don't become householders and their lineage, we are taking upon ourselves the greatest sin of destruction that can come upon the world. You must be able to change this. So, as far as I am concerned, everyone certainly knows that there is disease, difficulty, hardship, and suffering. But there is no need for this disease to come. At the same time, there is no need to suffer. People will bring whatever is needed for two, four, or ten people to survive. That will be enough. But that is not our goal. Seeing the right and wrong that have come in the tradition, we must pass it on to our children and whatever generations and lineages are yet to come. When we say lineages, it refers to the three types of worship orders among Hindus called Shaktheyam, Shaivam, and Vaishnavam. The path of our doctrine is to understand the karmic movements standing in this divine presence or star constellations beyond that, act upon it, and give it to our lineage. If this path is not clear to you, you won't be able to do it in any way. During the different transitional states of this, I have suffered some physical ailments. That can happen to anyone. But for others, it has usually led them to death. Except for the fact that death did not occur, all other pains have come. You had a perception before. We have a tradition behind us that has seen, heard, known, practiced, and observed the karmic systems of thousands of yogishwaras who practiced yoga, and some paths known through wisdom. There are certain special rules to know how to remove it and bring it before us, and through whom it should be brought forward. But I am not in a position to explain all that today. You will be told about all this. Since my physical condition today doesn't allow me to summarize and explain all this, someone among them will tell you about it. Because of passing through various states, the body has been damaged. Now, my soul has no damage, but the body is damaged. I cannot describe what it is right now. Therefore, please understand it at your own pace. Then, they will explain the reason and significance of this event called prayer now. Whatever it is, do it properly. Now, most people among us are not capable of making us understand in the way we need. However, it can be achieved through our effort and through karmas we undertake with repentance. What is it? If we do not regret past actions, we cannot take this up. You should be told about that too. There are several such subjects, many additional subjects. From them, we will listen briefly to one or two subjects and then go for prayer. If one person has come from our house, if it is not understood by everyone in that house and, if necessary, by the neighbors, and if it doesn't reach the people, it will become a great sin we commit against ourselves. We must understand the karma that if God has given us an opportunity and we do not accomplish it, there is a punishment for it.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Dedication Edition 2004
He who speaks has not seen, he who has seen does not speak.

The fourth face is a special manifestation of the imagination of knowledge. It cannot be corrected or modified. It is regarding such a face that the term 'Nanmukhan' (four-faced) is used. If this passes through the Trinity or the three faces, it will only be creative. A dissolutive special imagination that the disciple earns is also the essence of the Guru. In that path, the Guru-disciple relationship does not differentiate between male and female here. That itself is the Supreme Brahman. It is a truth that can only be repeated for the Guru and the disciple. It will seem like nothing on that path is learned or acquired. It will feel like in that Guru's life and growth, nothing is learned or acquired. Only the disciple will know that everything emanates from within himself without his conscious knowledge. Only the disciple can know the Guru. No one else can know. Such disciples are of thousands of types. Just as these seven notes are expanded into sixty-four musical notes, wherever the note ultimately settles, that is the Guru. The one who understands that is the disciple. That is why it is said that only the disciple speaks, and the Guru does not. When a scholar applied intellect to this and brought in their knowledge system, they wrote that the one who speaks has not seen, and the one who has seen does not speak. That is an act merely fit to be written by imitating the style of these vowels and consonants. How can one know the truth through this? The true word of the Guru is experienced by the disciple without it being spoken. Then one must come into the realization that the Guru and the disciple are one. There is no physical manifestation there. What can be said about the stupidity of writing a commentary just because Advaita was written down! They turn this very stupidity into their scholarship. And then, by speaking of it somewhere, they proclaim themselves as scholars. It means there is no experience. This is the stupidity of the scholar. All those who learned by hearing this repeat the same thing. Remaining here without male or female distinction, they named it Parashakti—simply because they had nothing else to say. Just like going to retrieve a coconut fallen in a mud pit, both the one who took it and the one who didn't got stuck there. Or like going to retrieve a seed fallen in a mud pit. They kept this hidden in the dark. But then, like the Englishman's tale, it sprouted inside. Pitch darkness, new moon. So, blackness. Complete blackness. It is a lid made of black. Inside it, a black cat. The cat understands that there is darkness only when it opens its eyes. This is a story of an Englishman. Will it open if covered with a story like this? It shouldn't be a story, it must become an experience. Now, our people who practice yoga, through asana demonstrations, assign it various other languages and narrate tales of an eight-span body. That will be correct according to their respective hand spans. Will it be correct for a little boy? If it is correct for him to that extent, it simply means it corresponds to whatever his size is. So, yoga is often discussed by incorporating such span measurements. Will things work if this is merely written or spoken about? This is not something that can be measured or written down like that. It is hastily spoken and hastily concluded. About this, Narayana Guru also says: 'One must fall, bow repeatedly, and recite'. When a scholar says this, the word 'repeatedly' loses its meaning. How can he fall repeatedly? Before one thing breaks, another bursts forth. Thus, it turned into an untrue trick constructed within the scholar's hidden strategy. Who can fulfill this? How can it be fulfilled? This is where it becomes a state where the disciple has nothing to share and the Guru has nothing to share, and the consciousness of changing states and differences disappears. It is a chain-like structure of non-existent disguises that teaches names like Dvaita and Advaita. It will seem like everything is there. But there is nothing there. That chain form is of karma. If that is gone, with what will you bind it? For this, saying Hatha Akasha, Hoda Akasha—thus citing Akasha in everything, ending up in a logician's language, speaking so hastily, and moving forward without caring for anything—how does one stand? For a person who goes without caring for anything, it is easy to speak about Advaita. When examining the karma and dharma paths of the commentator, it is like they built and built, made it dark, and closed their eyes. It is because they cannot explain the meaning of this 'repeatedly' that they close their eyes and create darkness. This love, respect, humility, and richness that grew in the light of time were all nurtured without a divisive intellect. The discrimination between the self and non-self mentioned by the author of the Gita, and the dedication of the self and non-self—whoever can do that is the Guru. The ability to say this, aside from the author of the Gita, has not been seen to this day. Or if it has been said, it is merely the iron fist of Vedanta's haste. It will not reveal the truth. Dvaita and Advaita are attained by climbing the steps of the Guru-disciple relationship in many ways. What is needed is not carefully explaining its meaning. Vowels and consonants are not required for this. In dissolutive love, glory, and truth, without the intrusion of disrespect, it becomes a merging of fortune and merit—the unadorned steps of the Guru-disciple relationship. This is the Guru-disciple bond. This is not something to be accomplished by pretending to be scholars or non-scholars using vowels and consonants. The result of people writing endlessly and posing as scholars in various ways is the gathering of literal meanings, thereby sowing the seeds of a difficult impasse. This is a crop that can never be harvested.
Guruvani

A Message for the Welfare of the People

When we acquire a god, a goddess, and a lineage, it is spoken of highly. We have become incapable of knowing where the history of the *Nanmukhan* (four-faced Brahma) has gone, which was formulated by blending the positions of the Trinity (*Trimurti*) with the concepts of the Siddhars and the enlightened ones (*Jnanis*). It is said that many people asked Narayana Guru Swami about these matters. He gave no reply. It was Velutheri Kesavan Asan and Thirunelli Krishnan Vaidyar who posed this question. None of the learned scholars to date have been able to explain what the status of this Trinity and the status of the *Nanmukhan* actually entail. This represents the history of a specific era in India. It is also said that many have logically dismissed its core. Certain other aspects have reached us through individuals who tore pages from historical truth to rewrite them. The reason for this is that it is the lineage of Manu that interprets everything, encompassing all worldly nature. However, to those who have studied extensively, certain elements may appear correct while others seem erroneous. These concepts of right and wrong can be observed if one meticulously examines the history of our Supreme Lord Sree Krishna. But what we have come to know is a situation where poets and their fundamental nature fled in defeat, arrived, and vanished, merely to achieve historical milestones. When examining the timeframe of all our religious doctrines, what we observe is a minor detail. In your own life, you are born, you grow, and you die. Within this span, what is displayed is the extraordinary valor of great souls who went about fabricating tales when the scholar, the ignoramus, and the rogue fled in defeat. It has been written that an era wherein we fight among ourselves and somehow evaluate and reflect upon this is not one we are entitled to. This is what has been written and referred to as the *Manusmriti*. Through this, which foundation do we possess? Is it the foundation of the Trinity? Or is it the passage where Narayana Guru states that the lamp which illuminates upon the cessation of the triad (*Triputi*) cannot be attained by a hypocritical ascetic? Similarly, the Brahmins have also been deceived in numerous ways. When we speak of these Brahmins, what we have heard about is *Karma* (action). How much of this *Karma* can we possibly witness and write about while we are alive!

If this is brought before a great scholar, they will merely read out the names of several books to those who approach them expressing their genuine sorrow. Every book elaborates upon miraculous powers, the disciplines of Yoga, and the protocols of *Karma*. Along with this, one is expected to assume the role of an ignorant believer or devotee. How can this possibly provide an elucidation concerning the *Dharma* of transitional epochs (*Yugantara Dharma*)?

After Krishna, two thousand four hundred and forty-four followers of the Guru's path have appeared. The same applies to Christians. It is said that Islam burst forth from this. Be that as it may. Let us not argue over it. This is because a period of one thousand five hundred years has been attributed to its functioning here. If one clearly and affectionately asks them about this, they will have nothing to say. It involves all the gods, goddesses, and the visionaries who came and went during that interim. From their perspective, all of this is indeed the truth. Why is it proceeding in this manner? No one will be able to provide an answer to that. The reason is simply the ignorance regarding what the *Yuga Dharma* (the law of the epoch) truly is. Numerous branches, which such great men have investigated and stumbled upon, constitute the fundamental wealth of our nation. Multiple attempts have been made to make you understand this in the context of a Guru lineage (*Guru Parampara*). However, consider whether we have not inherited from our predecessors a *Karma* that has stumbled and collapsed under the weight of your intellectual prowess, familial prestige, and academic sophistry! I am telling you this merely to clarify it. You will not understand this easily—that there is an inability to guide your children onto that path. It is the knowledge of a mother who survives merely by straining her vocal cords that resides within the child. To whom, how, and in what manner will this knowledge be questioned? If you yourselves openly discuss these matters within your homes, there is no need to generate such a massive uproar about it. You may examine the calculations of the *Chaturyugas* that have come and gone over these twenty-five *Chaturyugas*—you will find it. It should not be sought through mere scholarly study. Where and how did your Guru act? In what manner were you a witness to that at the time? God has created a lineage to enable you to reclaim this. Men and women must not corrupt this by committing errors. It is not that the aspect of the Trinity and the *Manusmriti* do not exist. Similar is the lineage of the prophets. When they stand before a God brimming with compassion, possessing occult powers (*Siddhi*), abilities, and mastery over mantras, they will render all their capabilities entirely useless before departing. Do not question how we have received this now. Because foundational sciences divided epochs into four and prescribed them as Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra. How long do we think its duration might have been? Unless learned directly from the lips of a Guru, no one can explain these matters. Everyone knows that, as far as you are concerned, all these matters are true. How many great souls have appeared before us to live and learn for the sake of this truth!

Similarly, demonic actions (*Paishachika Karma*) are described in numerous ways. If we keep completing all of these, across how many epochs have we been returning with destructive actions that lead to death and ruin! You have compiled and documented various pieces of evidence for this with the help of those who hold affection. I have also heard some people mentioning this to children. In all those times, I felt that what they were saying was indeed correct. Our governance system represents the acquisition of an ability for India to embrace such a fortune. If they and you contemplate and ask how this should be approached, asking them will yield no results. Consequently, the entire human world, having arrived at this demonic *Karma*, is incapable of discerning what the *Karma* of the father is, what the *Karma* of the mother is, or what the *Karma* of the child is. Therefore, do not proceed by squandering your time. Divine retribution is not merely limited to our nature; our ancestors have beautifully and with solid evidence documented world affairs and the global sphere. However, these scholars will not acknowledge it. When we speak of scholars, we have two types, do we not? If one attempts to resolve one, there is neither root nor branch to be found anywhere.

The divine causality (*Ishwara Nidanam*) was first demonstrated here by the lineage of the Buddha. Although the truth was spoken, it could not be practically lived out. This is being stated so that all of you may comprehend. Here, one can travel by bus, by bicycle, by bullock cart, or on foot. Consider this as an analogy. This is not the primary subject. I shall elucidate all of that subsequently. Thus, everyone, all of you, must safeguard your lives in a manner that leads to true knowledge. It is for this very purpose that you performed *Gurupooja* (worship of the Guru). However, you have not grasped the true essence of *Gurupooja*. That will be explained later. If you do not fiercely protect it, it will transform into an affliction bestowed by God. Each aspect lies behind a truth that you can perceive in detail. Most people generally refuse to accept this.
Guruvani

March 2005. We must first examine the causes of our nation's degradation. It is here that we have committed our most significant errors. The primary mistake concerning our nation stems from initially adhering to certain ways of life—resulting either in its inherent deficiencies or in a form of governance tainted with wickedness. This has been our predicament. In the context of such governance and the ensuing wickedness, our ignorance has led to profound failures that are entirely unjustifiable. This phenomenon is not confined merely to our region or to India; it has occurred globally. However, regarding our capacity to rectify this, our developed critical thinking remains ambiguous. We lack clear guidance on what actions to take today or how to approach these issues, resulting in individuals merely acting according to their own limited understanding without achieving anything substantial. We can briefly examine the root of this failure. It is not minor, but rather profound, though expressing it thus might be difficult for you to accept. Sri Krishna was born prior to the *Kali Yuga*, or more precisely, at the juncture of the *Kali* and *Dwapara Yugas* (the conclusion of one and the commencement of another). In a sense, this represented a profound burden of sorrow, the magnitude of which we have yet to fully comprehend. However, by misinterpreting this, teaching it inappropriately, and attributing everything to the author of the *Gita*, both scholars and the laity fall into an innumerable series of traps. How can one even begin to quantify them? Therefore, this is not what we require today. What the author of the *Gita* stated is accurate. Have we truly accepted the author of the *Gita*? If so, in what manner? This is where our error lies. When asked if we have anything meaningful to say about the long history ordained by divine will across ages, the answer is negative. We consider the pedantic parsing of words to be the highest intellectual achievement, and we each hide behind this superficial cleverness. However, will such pedantic analysis bring any spiritual benefit to your soul, my soul, or any soul in this world? Such exercises merely serve as intellectual entertainment. You will find yourself incapable of performing actions that are genuinely beneficial to your life. Consequently, while existing in a state where you are told that the era of your birth is the *Kali Yuga*, and that *Kali* is detrimental, how can we possibly rectify our situation? You must realize that *Kali* is never inherently evil. That is the most profound truth. What does this mean? We stand in opposition to the divine will that provided the *Shudra* with the opportunity to attain the knowledge of *Brahman*. Sri Krishna serves as a prime example of this.

The history of Kamsa demonstrates the anomalies that existed here even prior to the birth of Sri Krishna. We have been taught that Kamsa was inherently evil. This is fundamentally incorrect. Kamsa was a king. He fulfilled the duties incumbent upon a king (*Raja Dharma*). However, we have failed to comprehend the extent and manner in which this *Raja Dharma* should be executed, or our position within the conceptual framework of the *Yuga Dharma* (duties of the era). Consequently, what has happened to us? As the poet Asan noted, "the mistakes committed yesterday become the established doctrines of today," and so it has come to pass. We remain unaware that we are committing errors. Consider the profound sorrow of parents whose seven infants were ruthlessly killed prior to Sri Krishna's birth. Our historical understanding suggests that he killed all seven and spared the eighth solely because it evaded his grasp. If this account is accurate, what were the consequences of failing to cultivate knowledge about Sri Krishna or failing to generate any benefit or awareness for the subjects? Alternatively, in a region governed by numerous rulers—over six hundred provincial kings—the virtues of one king were absent in another. It is as if they were trapped in a vortex of conflict and conquest, or rather, languishing and suffering within it. Thus, we have merely wasted time observing the ignorance propagated by these kings day by day, or analyzing the achievements of our scholarly lineages, without ever truly understanding or acting upon this knowledge. We still remain incapable of doing so. The circumstances surrounding Sri Krishna's birth evolved in this manner. Yet, the populace of that time lacked the understanding necessary to protect Sri Krishna. Or perhaps, the kings lacked this understanding. Consequently, despite being shown the reality of this king, or the true nature of Kamsa's life, we failed to comprehend it. Kamsa was never an evil person. What then is the principle? It is '*Pratyakshavaham Dharmam*' (Dharma is that which is directly perceived or commanded).

A king is one who listens to whoever explicitly reveals the truth to him. Thus, God stood manifest before him. Standing in that manifestation, what did God do? He dictated *Dharma* to him. Therefore, aside from the fact that he steadfastly acted upon that perceived *Dharma*, Kamsa committed no crime. He killed each infant in accordance with the command he received. The greatest tragedy, however, is that the contemporary kings, scholars, or the wise lacked the intellectual tradition to analyze why he acted in this manner, or to correct and guide him from a position of true knowledge. Why were they unable to offer this corrective guidance? That is another aspect. Our primary occupation consists of recalibrating the magnitude of our ritual offerings, operating under the framework of the currently popular *Trimurti* system, or the sectarian paths of *Shakta*, *Shaiva*, and *Vaishnava* traditions that we individually celebrate. We labor under the delusion that we have satisfied the divine through these means. We can never achieve this. Furthermore, a being thus appeased is not truly God. What then is the reality? There is something we must believe. Why? We construct a temple. Yet, we remain ignorant of what transpired through the lineage of that temple, the temporal scope of the actions of the ancestors who worshipped there, and our current existential position. We have not been instructed on the role of temple traditions within the *Dharma* of this *Kali Yuga*. Additionally, it is universally propagated that the *Treta Yuga* and *Dwapara Yuga* were the specific eras of this deity. Because of this inability to discern, its *Dharma* was executed in the *Satya Yuga*. Its *Dharma* was similarly executed in the *Treta* and *Dwapara Yugas*. However, we find it difficult to believe that this occurred within a Guru lineage. Why? We have before us the practices of even the sages (*Rishis*) who worshipped and adored this deity. But we have not acquired the knowledge to explain the underlying reasons for this. What is the cause? We lack detailed information concerning this *Manvantara*. Or rather, we are ignorant of several critical matters. A *Manvantara* refers to the epoch of a specific *Manu*. The duration of a *Manu's* epoch is said to be seventy-one *Chatur Yugas*. Within these seventy-one *Chatur Yugas*, this *Kali Yuga* represents the smallest measurable fraction.
Guruvani
